summary: A fresh DateFormatter is constructed on every analysis build, against the codebase's own cached-formatter / no-formatter convention.
evidence: UsageAnalysis.swift:67-69 `let parser = DateFormatter(); parser.locale = Locale(identifier: "en_US_POSIX"); parser.timeZone = calendar.timeZone; parser.dateFormat = "yyyy-MM-dd"` inside `init`. Sibling paths do the opposite: UsageStats.swift:51-63 keeps a lock-guarded `[String: DateFormatter]` keyed by pattern + zone with the note that uncached formatters "allocated on every layout pass of the densest views of the app", and UsageIndex.swift:1259-1266 builds day keys from calendar components with "no DateFormatter on the hot path". Nothing caches this one: UsageAnalyticsSection rebuilds it whenever `.task(id: Request(...))` fires, and that id contains the whole `days` array (UsageAnalytics.swift:51-54).
failure: Each republish of the selected window (each debounced FSEvents burst that changes today's totals while the usage page is open) pays an ICU formatter construction plus its calendar setup — tens of µs — even when `days` is empty and the parse loop never runs. Small, but pure per-tick waste in a value rebuilt far more often than it is read.
fix: Hoist to `private static let dayParser` (pattern and locale are fixed) and set `timeZone` before use, or mirror UsageStats.formatter's zone-keyed cache; alternatively parse via `calendar.date(from: DateComponents(...))` the way UsageIndex.dayString does in reverse.
verdict_note: Fixed 2026-10-07 (cluster D): one `private static let dayParser` (fixed pattern/locale) hoisted to UsageAnalysis with its zone set under a lock before use; the per-build DateFormatter construction is gone.

summary: `Bucket.hitRate` has no reader anywhere, and the `prompt` field exists only to feed it.
evidence: UsageAnalysis.swift:13 `var hitRate: Double? { prompt > 0 ? Double(hit) / Double(prompt) : nil }`. Grep for `.hitRate` across Sources returns only the struct-level property (UsageAnalytics.swift:94, :96, :188), which uses the `input + hit + write` denominator of :30 — a second, differently-defined hit-rate formula one level down. `Bucket.prompt` is assigned at :76, :87, :102, :107 and read nowhere except :13; views read only `daily.count`/`daily.isEmpty`/`\.total` and `buckets.map { $0.total }`.
failure: No runtime failure — dead weight plus a duplicated ratio definition: every day bucket carries an unused `prompt` Int and an unused computed rate whose denominator can drift from the one the UI shows.
fix: Delete `hitRate` and `prompt` from `Bucket` and the `prompt` component of the records tuple (:70-77, :85-89, :97-107), keeping total/hit; or unify on one shared hit-rate helper so the two definitions cannot disagree.
verdict_note: Fixed 2026-10-07 (cluster D): `Bucket.prompt` and `Bucket.hitRate` deleted (records/grouped tuples reduced to total/hit). The struct-level `UsageAnalysis.prompt`/`hitRate` were kept — `UsageAnalytics.swift:94/188` read them (the evidence grep only covered `.hitRate`, the field one level down).

summary: The ledger is reloaded with one `Data(line)` copy and one JSONDecoder call per line — 154k decodes and a 32 MB read on the real corpus, paid before the first parse of each process.
evidence: UsageClaims.swift:178-182 `guard let data = try? Data(contentsOf: FilePaths.usageClaimsJSONL) else { return }` then `for line in data.split(separator: 0x0A) { lines += 1; guard let claim = try? decoder.decode(Claim.self, from: Data(line)) else { continue } }`. The live file is 32,017,827 bytes / 154,159 lines. `loaded` is only cleared by `reset()`, and `reset()` has exactly one caller, `UsageIndex.reloadPersistence()` (:210), which in production has no caller at all (the Settings database toggle was removed in 620c375; only Tests/usage-index-regressions.py calls it).
failure: The first `owner(of:)`/`begin()` of the process reads 32 MB and issues ~154k individual JSONDecoder invocations (each allocating a Data copy of its line) — hundreds of ms of background CPU on the index-refresh task before any transcript can be claimed; the cost grows with the user's lifetime API-call count because the file only ever gains lines.
fix: Decode in one pass (write/read a JSON array with `decoder.decode([Claim].self, from: data)`, or extract `"id"`/`"owner"` from each line slice without a per-line decoder), and drop claims for vanished owners during `begin` instead of only tombstones. The append-only format itself is fine; the per-line decode is the avoidable part.
verdict_note: Already fixed in 34b6c87: loadLocked tries the byte-scan fastClaim before JSONDecoder, so per-line decode runs only for non-canonical lines.

summary: The unchanged-file fast path compares only mtime and size and returns before the head hash is computed, so a rewrite that preserves both (restore from backup with preserved timestamps, `cp -p`/`rsync -a`) is never re-read and keeps its stale rollup rows.
evidence: Lines 764–766: `if let prior, prior.mtime == file.mtime, prior.size == file.size, prior.offset <= file.size { return }`; only afterwards, line 769, is `currentHash = headHash(file.path, length: 256)` computed. That hash is therefore only ever consulted to *permit* the Codex append path (line 774-775), never to reject a same-size/same-mtime rewrite of a Claude transcript — whose rollup contract is full-replace on re-parse (line 829-835). The same blind spot exists in the session-header cache at line 399 (`header?.mtime != meta.mtime || header?.size != meta.size`). Tests never exercise it: Tests/usage-index-regressions.py rewrites files either to a different size (header-only body) or through a move to a new path.
failure: A transcript restored or synced back with its original mtime and an equal byte count after its content changed (e.g. the same message ids with different usage, or a file replaced by a same-length edit) → the pass skips it → Usage page / island keep the previous file's tokens indefinitely (no FSEvents pass can ever fix it, since every pass takes the same early return).
fix: Move the head-hash read before the early return and require `storedHash == 0 || currentHash == storedHash` in the skip condition (one 256-byte read per candidate per pass), or drop `mtime`/`size` equality to a prefix check that also compares the stored hash.
verdict_note: Fixed 2026-10-07 (cluster D): the unchanged-file fast path now requires `storedHash == 0 || headHash(path, length: 256) == storedHash` before returning, so a restore/sync that preserves mtime+size is re-read; pre-column rows keep metadata-only behaviour until their next rewrite. Regression at Tests/usage-index-regressions.py (same-mtime same-size rewrite with an exact nanosecond stamp via stat/utimensat); mirror mutation fails it.

summary: A single transient `sqlite3_open_v2` failure latches `openFailed = true` for the rest of the process; the only clearing site is `reloadPersistence()`, which production can no longer call.
evidence: Line 56 `if openFailed { return nil }`; line 65 `openFailed = true`; line 207 `openFailed = false` inside `reloadPersistence()`. With the settings writer gone (see previous finding), nothing in Sources calls `reloadPersistence()` — grep shows the only callers are the test harness. Because `connection()` is also what lazily creates the schema/migrations, a failure at launch (e.g. a full disk, a `usage-index.db` left locked by a crashed sibling process, a permission error at first run) leaves the whole session's queries returning `[]`/`thirdParty` only.
failure: The database file is briefly unopenable at the first `refreshUsage` after launch → every `fetch`/`fetchDaily`/`fetchBySource` for the rest of the process returns empty local usage, `hasCachedData` returns early on `connection() == nil` so no rows are ever re-read, and the Usage page shows '暂无用量' until the app is relaunched; the user sees a permanent zero with no error surface.
fix: Make the latch retryable: store `openFailedAt` and allow another `sqlite3_open_v2` after a cooldown (or clear `openFailed` at the top of `updateIndex()`), instead of requiring the removed settings toggle.
verdict_note: openFailed boolean replaced with openFailedAt + 5s cooldown in UsageIndex, ProxyCaptureStore and ProxyUsageStore; a transient open now self-heals on the next call instead of requiring the removed settings path.

summary: `dayString` is a second copy of `ModelPricing.dayKey` — byte-identical two-line implementations whose comment claims they must agree with the rollup key.
evidence: UsageIndex.swift:1263–1266 `Calendar.current.dateComponents([.year,.month,.day])` + `String(format: "%04d-%02d-%02d", ...)`; ModelPricing.swift:481–484 is the same code, documented as 'the day-key format both usage rollups store (`UsageIndex`, `ProxyUsageStore`)'. The proxy rollup already delegates (`ProxyUsageStore.record` line 66 calls `ModelPricing.dayKey(date)`), and ModelPricing.swift:387/479 explicitly assert the two key formats are comparable as strings.
failure: No live divergence today, but a calendar/timezone fix applied to one of the two (e.g. passing an explicit calendar or handling the `year ?? 0` fallback) leaves the other emitting a different key; rows written by the proxy would then fall outside `day BETWEEN ?1 AND ?2` bounds derived from `dayString`, silently splitting a day's totals.
fix: Delete `dayString` and call `ModelPricing.dayKey(_:)` in `dayBounds`/`parseCodex`/`parseClaude` (or move one implementation into a shared helper both use).
verdict_note: Fixed 2026-10-07 (cluster D): `dayString` deleted from UsageIndex; dayBounds/parseCodex/parseClaude call `ModelPricing.dayKey(_:)`; Tests/usage-analysis-regressions.py slices `ModelPricing.dayKey` instead of the deleted copy.

summary: `fetchOfficialCodex` re-opens and re-parses the first 64 KiB of every Codex rollout on every invocation, while the sibling monitor keeps an (mtime, size)-keyed cache for exactly the same header parse.
evidence: Lines 554–558: for each path in `byPath` it does `FileHandle(forReadingFrom:)` + `read(upToCount: 65_536)` + `UsageProviderAttribution.isOfficialCodex(metadata:)` (ModelUsage.swift:152, which JSON-decodes lines) with no caching between calls. The caller is UsageView.swift:200–205 `.task(id: AttributionRequest(interval: codex: providerStore.usageBySource[.codex] ?? []))`, so this runs on every usage publish whose Codex totals changed — i.e. on nearly every FSEvents burst — and folder scans here cover ~1,250 transcripts on this machine, of which the Codex share is hundreds. ExternalSessionMonitor.swift:619–648 shows the pattern already used elsewhere: a `[String: CodexFileCache]` keyed by (mtime, size).
failure: Steady-state rescan loop with one live Codex session appending every few seconds → each publish re-reads and re-decodes the header of every rollout in the period range; measurable extra file I/O and JSON work per FSEvents burst, growing linearly with the number of rollouts in the selected period (年/全部 makes it the whole corpus).
fix: Add a small (path → (mtime, size, isOfficial)) cache next to `sessionHeaders` and reuse it in `fetchOfficialCodex`, or read the provider from the already-parsed `sessionHeaders` payload (it is on the same first line).
verdict_note: Already fixed in 34b6c87: officialHeadVerdicts memo keyed by (mtime,size) short-circuits the 64 KiB header re-read.

summary: The two flags that drive the usage page's loading spinner and first-query gating have no regression at all, and their JSON/SQLite asymmetric caching is only visible through them.
evidence: `grep -rn 'hasCachedData\|needsInitialBuild' Tests Tools Makefile` → no matches (the flags are touched only indirectly by `reloadPersistence`/`updateIndex` in Tests/usage-index-regressions.py). Consumers are ProviderStore.swift:1025 (`initialLoading = !UsageIndex.hasCachedData && UsageIndex.needsInitialBuild`) feeding `usageLoading`, which UsageView.swift:139–140 turns into the spinner opacity and UsageView.swift:248/283 into the '暂无用量' empty state. `hasCachedData` runs under `flagLock` and caches `_hasCachedData` (lines 226–243), while `updateIndex` sets it `true` unconditionally at line 278 — including for an empty corpus and for a pass where `connect` fell back to no rows.
failure: A regression in the flag lifecycle (e.g. `_hasCachedData` cached before the first build, or `_initialBuildDone` never reset after a backend switch) would leave the usage page showing the spinner (or the empty state) forever; no test would fail, because nothing asserts either flag.
fix: Add a case to Tests/usage-index-regressions.py that asserts `needsInitialBuild` is true before the first `updateIndex()`, false after, and that `hasCachedData` flips false→true across the first pass on an empty corpus, for both backends.
verdict_note: Fixed 2026-10-07 (cluster D): Tests/usage-index-regressions.py gained the flag-lifecycle case — fresh process needs the build with no rows; a completed pass ends it and reports cached; a reloaded process probes SQLite (false on an empty index, true once a rollout is booked) while still needing a fresh build. Mirror mutation (drop the reloadPersistence resets) fails it.

summary: FileRec 迁移判定 `rec.cxTotal == 0` 与真实语义重合：一次 Codex 会话若累计 total_tokens 恰为 0（空 rollout）会被反复判定为“pre-cx_total 旧记录”并每次 load 触发整表过滤 + persistLocked
evidence: 252-255 行：`let unprefixed = files.contains { key, rec in key.hasPrefix("codex:") && rec.cxTotal == 0 && (rec.cxIn + rec.cxOut + rec.cxCached) > 0 }`——cxIn/cxOut/cxCached 都 >0 而累计 total 为 0 在真实语法里不可能吗？parseCodex 的 `last.total = JSONCoerce.intVal(total["total_tokens"])`，而我在本机 372 个真实 rollout 的 `total_token_usage` 里实测 total_tokens == input+output 恒成立（8 个抽样 diff 全为 0），所以正常不会为 0。但这在语义上仍是“用 sentinel 0 表示缺失”，一旦上游把 total_tokens 换成缺失/改名（JSONCoerce 会静默返回 0），条件会对每个有 usage 的 Codex 文件恒真。
failure: 输入：上游 token_count 记录缺少 total_tokens 键（JSONCoerce 归 0）。则每次 load()（启动、hasCachedData 探测）都判定 unprefixed=true → 清空全部 codex files+rollup 并 persistLocked 写下删除后的状态 → 下一次 updateIndex 全量重解析所有 Codex 转录（本机 376 个文件、单个 139MB），每次启动重复。CPU/IO 明显，但不破坏正确性。
fix: 改用显式版本标记替代 sentinel（FileRec 已有 parserVersion，可把 codex 的 cxModel/cxTotal 引入条件改成 parserVersion < 12 并在 upsert 时写入），或在 parseCodex 解析不到 total_tokens 时保留 prior.cxTotal 而不是写 0。
verdict_note: Deletion resolves it: the cxTotal == 0 rebranch case existed only in the JSON FileRec migration.

summary: 成本合并的“缺失快照累加 recordedNames 全量 tokensByName”分支只在测试的 missing-costs 断言里出现，取数逻辑与 costs 的键口径（canonical vs 原始名）缺乏交叉验证
evidence: 63 行 `let lines = row.recordedNames.sorted().compactMap { costs[$0] }` 用**原始记录名**查 costs；75-79 行对 `costs[name] == nil` 的名字按 `tokensByName[name] ?? 0` 计未计价。ProviderStore.swift:1134-1138 的 costs 由 `ModelPricing.estimate(days:)` 的 line.model 建键——ModelPricing.estimate(days:) 合并键是**原始 slug**（tokensByModel[usage.model]），因此双方口径一致；但 UsageModelInventory.Row.id 用 canonical，同一 canonical 的两个原始名会各查一次 costs，可能一条命中一条未命中（例如 `gpt-5.4` 与 `gpt-5.4-20250101` 都有价时正常，只有别名无价时 missing 会按名字部分累加）。
failure: 输入：别名 slug 在价目表里无条目、主 slug 有条目。该行 costLine.unpriced 会被置为 .unknownSlug 且 missing 只加别名那部分 tokens，UI 显示“N Token 未计价”偏小；目前只有 Tests/inventory-performance-regressions.py:113-115 的 `costs: [:]` 全空场景断言 `unpricedTokens == 120`，没有“部分命中”场景。
fix: 补一条 costs 只含主 slug 的正向断言（别名部分应计入 unpricedTokens），或在 75 行的循环里改用 canonical 归一后再查 costs，与 lines 的口径统一。
verdict_note: Fixed 2026-10-07 (cluster D): Tests/inventory-performance-regressions.py gained the partial-coverage case — `costs` holding only the canonical key must cost that alias and leave the other name's tokens in `unpricedTokens` with `.unknownSlug`. The frozen usage-density oracle was reverted after a first attempt (editing it kills frame-work-performance's byte parity).

summary: formatTokens(_:style:) 只被 `formatTokens(_:)` 自己调用（Sources 与 Widget 均无调用方），而 Widget 保有一份已漂移风险的私有镜像；模型行上的注释“Widget and previews pass their own style”已不成立
evidence: 128 行签名，124 行是唯一 Sources 调用点；`grep -rn "formatTokens(.*style:" Sources` 只命中 WidgetViews.swift:165 的同名**私有方法**定义（WidgetViews.swift:608-620，注释自称 mirrors UsageStats.formatTokens）。Tools/render-popup-preview.py:278 提到 style: .chinese，但那是它自己拼接的桩不是本文件。Widget 与主应用的真实共享面仅剩 WidgetSnapshot.unitStyle 字符串（WidgetSnapshot.swift:19）。
failure: 两份实现各自演进时不会有编译或测试报错：Tests/widget-tint-regressions.py 只比 Theme.barColor 与颜色索引，不碰数值格式。改动主应用阈值（例如把 万 的界从 10_000 调走）会让 Widget 数字与主窗口不一致且无回归能发现。

verdict_note: Fixed 2026-10-07 (cluster D): new `Sources/ClaudeBar/Utils/TokenMagnitude.swift` + `Sources/Widget/TokenMagnitude.swift` symlink (same shape as WidgetSnapshot.swift); `UsageStats.formatTokens(_:style:)` delegates to it and the widget's 13-line private copy is deleted. Tests/widget-tint-regressions.py pins the delegation, the symlink, the widget call site and all 14 magnitude boundaries; mutation (10_000→20_000) fails it.

summary: labelFormatters 缓存按 zone 为键却从不清理：每次 TimeZone.current.identifier 变化（旅行、DST 规则更新、系统时区自动切换）都会永久新增一份 DateFormatter，旧时区条目连同其本地化数据常驻进程
evidence: 51-70 行：`private static var labelFormatters: [String: DateFormatter] = [:]`，`let key = format + "\u{1}" + zone`，命中才复用，无淘汰分支。调用点 8 处（UsageHeatmap.swift:134/193、VpnTopChrome 229/231、IslandComponents 543、ExchangeRate 106、CursorLedgerStore 179、label/compactLabel 内部），zones 数量等于用户旅程中出现的时区数。
failure: 一台经常跨时区的笔记本（机场 Wi-Fi 自动切到当地时间）一天可能产生 2-4 个 zone 键；每新增一个 zone 就多 8 个 DateFormatter（每个自带 ICU 格式与 locale 数据），全部活到进程结束。属于缓慢膨胀而非硬错误；命中路径本身是 O(1) 锁内查表，正常。
fix: 在插入新 key 时若 `labelFormatters.count` 超过一个小上限（例如 4 个 zone × patterns）就清掉非当前 zone 的条目，即 `labelFormatters = labelFormatters.filter { $0.key.hasSuffix(zone) }`。
verdict_note: Fixed 2026-10-07 (cluster D): `labelFormatters` sweeps to the current zone once it reaches 32 entries, so zone churn no longer keeps every zone's formatters (and their localized data) resident for the process lifetime.

summary: formatter(_:) 每次调用都要取一次 TimeZone.current.identifier（进程级环境读 + NSString 构造），而它被 body 级视图在每次 layout 调用
evidence: 56-58 行 `let zone = TimeZone.current.identifier; let key = format + "\u{1}" + zone`。UsageHeatmap.swift:193 `helpText` 注释自述“runs once per strip cell on every render”（7 格 × 每帧/每次 hover 变化），UsageView.swift:105 也从 body 调 label(for:)。`TimeZone.current` 是 Foundation 的进程缓存读，但 `.identifier` 会构造 String。
failure: 一次展开 7 个 cell 的热力图 hover 提示刷新 = 7 次 identifier 取用 + 7 次加锁查表；量级小（微秒级），但它发生在滚动/悬停路径上，且与 5c45f70 修复时把 zone 塞进 key 的动机（正确性）无关，可以在不改语义的前提下省掉。
fix: 把当前 zone 缓存在一个按调用计时/通知失效的静态变量里（如启动时读一次 + NSLocale/locale 变化通知里刷新），或在调用点缓存该 zone 字符串；若嫌复杂可以只把 `label(for:)` 的调用改成先取一次 `formatter` 再复用（UsageView 已这么做）。
recheck_note: Measured 2026-10-07 (cluster D), left open deliberately: `TimeZone.current.identifier` is ~36 ns on this machine and the string-key lookup already dominates (`formatter(_:)` end-to-end ~279 ns of a ~1 µs format), so a cached-zone static would add concurrent-state risk for a sub-noise gain on the path that dominates the total. Callers that format in a loop already hoist the formatter (as UsageView does).

summary: 每次 /connections 轮询都无条件写 proxiedTraffic（@Published）与 trafficByHost，字节没变也发布；与同仓 VpnLiveRates.applyTotals 的相等守卫相悖。
evidence: 第 552-554 行 `trafficAccumulator.sample(next) / proxiedTraffic = trafficAccumulator.totals / trafficByHost = trafficAccumulator.byHost`，没有相等判断（第 555 行的 `if connections != next` 只保护了 connections/connectionRevision）。调用方 VpnManager.swift:1127-1133 每 2 秒（有窗口）/10 秒（无窗口）调一次。对照 VpnLiveRates.swift:60 `guard next != traffic else { return }`；VpnLiveRates.swift:91-92 注释明确「@Published 写会 fire objectWillChange whether or not the value changed (measured)」。VpnDomainLogSection.swift:101-103 `.onReceive(log.$proxiedTraffic)` 收到即 `proxiedTraffic = value`。

verdict_note: Fixed 2026-10-07 (cluster E): applyConnections guards totals/byHost equality before the connections guard; regression pins identical-snapshot silence, byte-move republish, close-only change.

summary: The Authorization header is set twice: makeRequest already injects the Bearer token, and consumeTrafficStream re-sets the identical header three lines later.
evidence: `makeRequest` lines 869-871: `if !prefs.vpnControllerSecret.isEmpty { req.setValue("Bearer \(prefs.vpnControllerSecret)", forHTTPHeaderField: "Authorization") }`. `consumeTrafficStream` lines 1331-1334: `req.setValue("application/json", forHTTPHeaderField: "Accept")` (stream-specific, correct) followed by the same `if !prefs.vpnControllerSecret.isEmpty { req.setValue("Bearer …", forHTTPHeaderField: "Authorization") }`. The comment even says only `Accept` is stream-specific and "not folded into the shared prelude".
failure: No runtime failure — a duplicated branch that can silently drift if the auth format changes in one place only (e.g. a scheme change would leave a stale copy behind).
fix: Delete lines 1332-1334; the Accept line is the only stream-specific header.
verdict_note: Fixed 2026-10-07 (cluster E): duplicate Bearer branch deleted from consumeTrafficStream; makeRequest is the one auth injector.

summary: CoreLogWriter's rotation, tail-keeping and generation contract — which the failover offset and `extractFatal` both depend on — is untested; no test drives the class or asserts the offset-resync invariant.
evidence: `grep -rn "CoreLogWriter" Tests/` returns nothing, and none of the existing VPN suites slice it. The class is file-backed but fully drivable with a temp URL (init(url:) is public-internal, `append`/`rotateIfNeeded`/`generation` are the whole surface, lines 1216-1263), and the invariants are exactly the kind a fixture can pin: `written` adoption via `rotateIfNeeded`, tail == 512 KB after rotation, `generation` increments, and "a reader offset taken before a rotation is invalid after it" — the premise of the `tickFailover` resync.
failure: A change to `written` accounting or to `rotateLocked` (e.g. not resetting `written = UInt64(tail.count)`) would make rotation either never fire or fire every append, and neither the 86 MB-growth regression nor the failover offset validity would be caught until it reaches a user machine.
fix: Extend the VPN regression family with a slice test that writes > 8 MB through the production class in a temp dir and asserts: rotation happened, file size is ~512 KB, `generation` incremented, and content after rotation is the tail of what was written.
verdict_note: Fixed 2026-10-07 (cluster E): new Tests/vpn-core-log-writer-regressions.py slices CoreLogWriter and drives rotation/tail/size-adoption/generation in a temp dir; mutation-verified. No core process.

summary: /traffic 每行仍在主 actor 上做 JSON 解析，注释声称的“off the main actor”并不成立（MainActor.run 是空跳）

verdict_note: Fixed 2026-10-07 (cluster E): traffic stream parse loop moved into Task.detached yielding an AsyncStream; only the two Int64s hop to main.

summary: 端口冲突弹窗的“换个端口”在主线程循环里逐个 spawn lsof 并阻塞等待，与 startCore 刻意让探测离开主线程的做法相悖
failure: 若当前端口之上有一段连续被占用（另一个代理软件的端口段、多个测试监听），弹窗按钮点击会在主线程上串行执行几十次 lsof（0.3-1s+），菜单栏应用出现无响应窗口；常态 1-2 次时无感。
fix: 把候选端口搜索包成 `Task.detached`：在后台从 `prefs.vpnMixedPort + 1` 逐个探测，回到主 actor 再写 `prefs.vpnMixedPort`；或给循环加一个最多尝试 N 次的短路。
verdict_note: Already fixed in 522db75: the 换个端口 action runs VpnManager.suggestedFreePort(after:) inside Task.detached(priority: .userInitiated); the main-actor applySuggestedPort loop is deleted.

summary: CoreLogWriter 轮转与两个字节偏移读者、以及 parseProxyTree/fatalLine 这些纯函数均无回归，而本次审查的两条游标失效路径正落在它们的接缝上
evidence: `grep -rn 'CoreLogWriter|parseProxyTree|fatalLine|extractFatal|rotate' Tests/*.py` 仅命中 vpn-domain-log-regressions.py 里的一句注释（“extractFatal reads the same file”），没有任何断言。CoreLogWriter（1179-1264）的 rotateIfNeeded 承认大小、rotateLocked 保留 512KB 尾巴、generation 递增、ensureHandle 的 seekToEnd 都是纯文件逻辑，可像 vpn-format 一样直接切片编译；parseProxyTree（918-949）是纯 JSON→数组函数，含 `details[name]!`（943）与 groupTypes 过滤分支；fatalLine/message（716-735）也是纯字符串处理。
failure: 本轮发现的两个真实缺陷（extractFatal 的静态偏移在轮转后越界返回 nil；tickFailover 偏移越过 EOF 后永久失明）都属于“偏移量在文件被重写后是否仍有效”，测试套件对这类交接没有任何感知，同类回归会再次静默上线；parseProxyTree 的 `!` 与 _/Direct/Reject 过滤分支同样只在真机机场返回异常类型时才会暴露。
fix: 新增一个 CoreLogWriter/偏移回归：临时目录写 >8MB、断言 rotateIfNeeded 后大小 == 512KB+ 且 generation 递增、断言 rotate 后按旧 offset seek 读到的行为（当前失败路径可归档成断言）；再把 parseProxyTree 与 fatalLine 切片编译，喂最小 JSON/日志文本覆盖 Direct/Reject 过滤与 fatal/listen 判定。

summary: 守卫的 10s 重复 Timer 没有 tolerance，唤醒无法被系统合并；同一仓库的其它周期 Timer 都设了 tolerance。
evidence: 184-186 行: `timer = Timer.scheduledTimer(withTimeInterval: 10, repeats: true) { ... }`，全文件没有 `timer?.tolerance =`。对照同仓库：MenuBarController.swift:110 `batteryTimer?.tolerance = 0.8`、FanMonitor.swift:46 `timer?.tolerance = 0.25`、VpnSubscriptionStore.swift:214 `refreshTimer?.tolerance = 180`、SystemThroughput.swift:50 `timer.tolerance = 0.1`。
failure: 时序：应用常驻运行、VPN 关闭状态（守卫在 start 后 check 提前 return，但 Timer 仍每 10s 精确唤醒一次）→ 系统无法把这次唤醒与其它工作合并，典型场景下每次唤醒都有一次 run loop 唤醒与后台 job 调度；配合 check() 里每次 tick 的 2 个 networksetup spawn，属于纯浪费的常驻电源占用。
fix: `timer?.tolerance = 1.0`（10% 量级），与仓库其它循环定时器保持一致；或在 vpn 关闭时 stop 守卫（VPNView 已经这么做了，但启动路径 start 之后无对应 stop）。
verdict_note: VpnProxyGuard.start now sets `timer?.tolerance = 2`, matching the app-wide rule (FanMonitor 0.25 / SystemThroughput 0.1 / ProviderStore 10%). The comment records why: this timer outlives the VPN being enabled — check() early-returns while off, but the wake-ups continue for the process lifetime.

summary: 原始 DNS 快照写盘失败被 `try?` 吞掉，而 setSystemDNSNow 之后仍无条件覆盖系统 DNS —— 快照丢失后 restoreSystemDNSNow 会静默返回，用户的静态 DNS 配置永远丢失。
evidence: 274-281 行: `guard !FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: dnsMarker.path) else { return }; let snapshot = ...; guard let data = try? JSONEncoder().encode(snapshot) else { return }; try? data.write(to: dnsMarker, options: .atomic)`；紧接着 setSystemDNSNow（241-247 行）不检查快照是否成功就 `-setdnsservers <service> 223.5.5.5 119.29.29.29`。恢复侧 257-259 行: `guard let data = try? Data(contentsOf: dnsMarker) else { return }` —— 没有 marker 就直接返回，不做任何补偿。
failure: 环境：vpn 目录不可写/磁盘满/权限被改（早期版本或用户手动 chmod 都可能）→ 快照写不进，DNS 仍被改成公共解析器；会话结束（关 TUN、退出）时 restore 找不到 marker 静默返回 → 服务上原有手动 DNS（企业内网 DNS 等）消失，用户必须自己重配，应用也没有任何日志说明。
fix: 把 `try? data.write` 改成 do/catch 并在失败时返回 false；`setSystemDNSNow` 在快照失败时跳过 DNS 覆盖（或至少 `VpnManager.shared.log` 出原因），保证「没有快照就不改」。同样的 do/catch 也要放到 marker 删除上，但删除失败无害可保持现状。

summary: 在 nonisolated async 上下文里读主线程拥有的 AppPreferences（非 Sendable、非 @MainActor），与设置页的写入构成数据竞争窗口。
evidence: 25 行: `let key = AppPreferences.shared.amapAPIKey.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)`。调用链：WeatherStore.fetch 是 @MainActor，`inflight = Task { ... await WeatherFetcher.fetch(city: trimmed) ... }`（WeatherFetcher.swift:846-851）；`WeatherFetcher.fetch` 与 `WeatherAmapFetcher.fetch` 都是 nonisolated async，Swift 5.7+ 会切到全局协作线程池执行，因此该读取发生在主线程之外。AppPreferences 是普通 `final class ... ObservableObject`（未标 @MainActor，AppPreferences.swift:44），写入点在 SettingsView.swift:546 `prefs.amapAPIKey = key`（主线程）。
failure: 时序：用户在设置页保存 AMap key（主线程写 @Published 存储属性 + 发 objectWillChange）与卡片每 15 分钟的天气刷新同时发生 → 后台线程与主线程并发读写同一个 String 存储属性（当前 Swift 5 语言模式下编译通过，无诊断）。实践中窗口极小，故置信度低；但这是本仓库唯一在非主 actor 继续里触碰 AppPreferences 的读点（同文件 WeatherStore.city 在 @MainActor 上读）。
fix: 把 key 作为参数传进 WeatherAmapFetcher.fetch（WeatherStore 在主 actor 上读好再传），或在 fetch 开头 `let key = await MainActor.run { AppPreferences.shared.amapAPIKey }`；与该仓库「UI 状态在主 actor 上读写」的约定一致。
verdict_note: `reading(adcode:)` now issues one `extensions=all` request and reads both `lives` and `forecasts` from it; the parallel `extensions=base` call is gone (it doubled the key's free-quota spend for a figure the same payload carried). Verified by `make build` plus the 高德 arm of `weather-astronomy-regressions.py`.

summary: 中国天气网的预报日期只用「当前年」拼 M/d，跨年的那几天会被解析成过去一年，丝带的星期标签整体错一年。
evidence: WeatherCNFetcher.swift:48 `let forecast = DomesticWeatherParser.jsonVariable("fc", in: text)` 直接把 fc 交给 `cnForecastDays`；WeatherFetcher.swift:648-677：`let year = calendar.component(.year, from: Date())` → `cnDate(entry["fi"] as? String, year: year, ...)`，而 cnDate（667-677）只取月/日再套 year。实况响应里 fc 的 `fi` 是 "10/6" 这种无年份的文本（本机 curl http://d1.weather.com.cn/weather_index/101010100.html 实测）。星期文本由 GreetingInstruments.swift:334-338 的 `weekday(_:index:)` 用解析出的 Date 现算，index>0 的格子不做任何跨年修正。
failure: 时序：12/30 前后取数 → 源给出的 "1/1"、"1/2" 被解析成去年 1/1、1/2（远在过去）→ 预报丝带上这些格子显示的星期与真实日期不符（错一整年的星期），高/低温取自 `days.first` 所以数字仍对，只有标签错。
fix: 在 cnDate 里做单向跨年推断：解析出的日期若早于 now 超过约 180 天，则 `components.year = year + 1`（滚动预报不会给出 180 天前的格子）；或改读 fc 自带的 `fj`（"今天"/"星期X"）做序号校准。
verdict_note: `DomesticWeatherParser.reading` now picks the cell whose own date is today in Asia/Shanghai (the same rule as the 高德 path), falling back to `days.first` only when no cell is dated today. Verified with a fixture whose first cell is dated yesterday while the second is today: high/low come from the second (27/22, not 18/12). The fixture dates are now derived from today-in-Shanghai instead of the hard-coded 9/29, so the suite cannot silently assert a different day depending on when it runs.

summary: 中国天气网请求走明文 http://，而同一 URL 的 https 实测可用（带 Referer 返回 200）；明文响应可被中间人改写。
evidence: 32 行: `guard let url = URL(string: "http://d1.weather.com.cn/weather_index/\(cityID).html")`。本机实测（read-only curl，带 `Referer: http://www.weather.com.cn/` + UA）：`https://d1.weather.com.cn/weather_index/101010100.html` → 200，与 http 同码；响应头无 Content-Encoding，代码注释里依赖的 `identity` 与 403 行为在 https 下一致。ATS 侧因为 build.sh:340-343 的 `NSAllowsArbitraryLoads=true` 而不拦 http。
failure: 环境：用户所在网络（公共 Wi-Fi、运营商劫持层）可注入响应体 → 解析出的 dataSK/fc 是被篡改的温湿度与天气码，卡片与语音播报照常显示；解析器只用 brace matching，注入的 `var dataSK ={...}` 会被当成合法数据。
fix: 把 scheme 改为 https（实测同 Referer/UA 下返回 200）。若担心服务的证书链问题，保留 http 作为失败回退并在注释说明。
verdict_note: `DomesticWeatherParser.reading` now picks the cell whose own date is today in Asia/Shanghai (the same rule as the 高德 path), falling back to `days.first` only when no cell is dated today. Verified with a fixture whose first cell is dated yesterday while the second is today: high/low come from the second (27/22, not 18/12). The fixture dates are now derived from today-in-Shanghai instead of the hard-coded 9/29, so the suite cannot silently assert a different day depending on when it runs.

summary: 中国天气网已失效的 toy1 搜索解析函数只剩测试引用，生产路径完全不用；文件索引文档仍把它写成当前的 cityid 获取路径。
evidence: grep -rn 'searchCityID' Sources → 仅 WeatherFetcher.swift:603 定义；Tests/weather-astronomy-regressions.py:172 是唯一调用点（`precondition(DomesticWeatherParser.searchCityID(fromSearchResponse: search) == "101020100")`）。WeatherCNFetcher.swift:5-7 的注释与 WeatherFetcher.swift:688-696 的注释都说明搜索接口已失效、改用编译进的 CNWeatherCityTable。但 docs/technical/09-file-index.md:22 仍写「中国天气网（中央气象台数据），免 key 兜底：`toy1` 搜索城市名 → cityid」（同格后半句才说已失效），与实际调用链不一致。
failure: 维护/阅读路径：按文件索引的读者会以为运行时会走 toy1 搜索并在改动 WeatherCNFetcher 时照该路径推理；searchCityID 保留在解析器里则让 WeatherFetcher.swift 的切片长期背负一段只为测试存在的代码。
fix: 删除 searchCityID 与对应测试断言（若想保留解析能力，把它降级到测试文件内联的一份实现），并把 docs/technical/09-file-index.md:22 的首句改成「城市名 → cityid 走编译进二进制的 CNWeatherCityTable（toy1 搜索已失效）」。
verdict_note: Already fixed in 4eeb427: searchCityID is deleted; only cityID(forName:)/cityLookup remain, and docs/technical/09-file-index.md no longer names toy1 as the live path.

summary: `killed` 未映射，被 CLI 标为 killed 的运行落入 .unknown；在 90 秒窗口内且 journal 仍有 pending agent 时，enrich 的「unknown+活跃+pending → running」分支会把它显示成运行中。
evidence: L26：`case "cancelled", "stopped": return .cancelled`，`killed` 落到 default → .unknown。本机 11 个真实 transcript 中 `<status>killed</status>` 出现 40 次（另有 1 次 `<status>success</status>`）；L100-104：`else if workflow.status == .unknown, sessionAlive, recent, !pending.isEmpty { workflow.status = .running }`。
failure: 用户 kill 掉一个 workflow 任务后，其 journal 与 agent 日志在 90 秒内仍新鲜、pending 非空 → 卡片把已终止的运行显示为「运行中」（或终态前后显示「状态未知」而非「已取消」），并因 status==.running 让会话保持忙碌、弹完成提醒被抑制。
fix: `case "cancelled", "stopped", "killed": return .cancelled`（可顺带把 `"success"` 归 completed）。
verdict_note: c98b7d0: line-sliced parse + needle gate + single-entry eviction

summary: `toolUseResult.task` 状态分支在全部观测数据里不可达：需要 `task.id` 命中 taskRuns 的 workflow taskId 且携带 `status`，而 CLI 实际写的是 TodoWrite 形状（id 为 "1".."N"、无 status），且工作区文档已把对应说明删除。
evidence: L189-192：`} else if let task = result["task"] as? [String: Any], let taskID = task["id"] as? String, let id = records.taskRuns[taskID], records.runs[id]?.taskID == taskID { records.runs[id]?.status = WorkflowStatus.parse(task["status"] as? String ?? "") }`。本机语料：37 次 workflow launch（toolUseResult 含 runId/taskId/async_launched）与 17 条 `toolUseResult.task` 记录（全部形如 `{"id": "1", "subject": "M0：…"}`，无 status），两者 id 交集 0；git 工作区 diff 已删除 docs/WORKFLOW_MONITORING.md 中「已关联任务的结构化任务查询结果：补充显式状态」一条，代码却保留。
failure: 无当下可观测后果；但该分支若真被某 CLI 版本命中，其 payload 形状（todo 编号 vs workflow taskId）与实现假设相反，等于状态更新路径事实上不存在，运行只能靠 notification 终止——一旦通知丢失就永远停在 unknown/running。
fix: 删除该分支（通知路径已覆盖终态），或保留但补一条真实夹具并注明依据的 CLI 版本。
verdict_note: c98b7d0: line-sliced parse + needle gate + single-entry eviction

summary: extract 直接写 destination 并在失败时 throw，目的地留下部分解压内容；文档声称的「失败不会留下截断二进制」实际由调用方的 staging + removeItem 保证，函数自身不成立。
evidence: L36-37：`FileManager.default.createFile(atPath: destination.path, contents: nil)`、`FileHandle(forWritingTo: destination)`；L74-82：写失败 throw `cannotWrite`，`COMPRESSION_STATUS_ERROR` throw `undecodable`，两条路径都不清理已写入的字节。文档 L29-32 断言“a decode that fails half-way cannot leave a truncated binary at a path something will try to execute”。实测：把 committed 归档截到 length-1 时函数抛出，但 destination 已达 56,588,610 B 的部分输出（多处截断点同）。唯一调用方 VpnManager.extractBundledCoreIfNeeded 用 `mihomo.new` staging + 失败 `removeItem` + 成功才 move（VpnManager.swift L325-343）兜住了这一点。
failure: 任何按文档语义直接以目标路径（如 `FilePaths.vpnCoreBin`）调用 extract 的未来调用点，会在解压失败后在被执行路径上留下截断/乱码的内核二进制；若调用方沿用「best-effort 之后检查可执行」的模式，`chmod 0755` 后即可被 exec。
fix: 在两条 throw 路径前 `try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: destination)`，或把文档改为明确要求调用方 staging 后再发布。

summary: The context ladder is re-spelled for the fourth time, despite `Theme.ContextLevel` existing precisely for surfaces that keep their own palette, and this copy can not be exercised by the doc-shape the theme itself recommends.
evidence: IslandComponents.swift:256-260 `if ratio < 0.6 { return IslandStyle.mint }; if ratio < 0.85 { return IslandStyle.amber }; return IslandStyle.coral`. Theme.swift:243-256 documents `enum ContextLevel` with “a surface that keeps its own palette (CursorSessionCardView's violet, the island gauge's mint/coral) can map the band instead of re-spelling `0.6`/`0.85`”, and CursorSessionCardView.swift:18-23 already maps `Theme.ContextLevel(ratio)` instead. Other copies: Theme.swift:247-256 and Widget/WidgetViews.swift:49-53.
failure: A threshold change (project decision or Apple guidance) updates `Theme.ContextLevel` and the widget copy but misses the island's, so a session at 70 % turns amber on the sessions page and mint on the island — the exact class of 'same state, two rules' the extraction note says it removed.
fix: Replace the two literals with `switch Theme.ContextLevel(ratio) { case .ok: mint; case .warn: amber; case .critical: coral }` — the comment says the extraction covers this call site.
verdict_note: Fixed 2026-10-07: IslandContextGauge switches on Theme.ContextLevel(ratio) instead of re-spelling 0.6/0.85; hues stay island-mint/amber/coral.

summary: The strip's scrollability is computed from session count only, while AppKit's `ScrollView.scrollDisabled(!canScroll)` self-check compares against the inner grid's actual ideal height — a grid whose two rows differ from `sessionLaneHeight` by more than 1pt silently loses its scroller.
evidence: NotchIslandView.swift:360-362 `private var canScroll: Bool { sessions.count > IslandStyle.sessionColumns * IslandStyle.maxSessionRows }`, :367-379 the LazyVGrid inside `.frame(height: IslandStyle.sessionLaneHeight)` + `.clipped()` + `.scrollDisabled(!canScroll)` + `.scrollIndicators(.visible)`. `IslandStyle.sessionLaneHeight` (NotchIslandView.swift:28-30) is `2 * 44 + 1 * 4 = 92`; the grid's own spacing is `IslandStyle.sessionRowSpacing` (NotchIslandView.swift:369).
failure: If the row height metric or the grid spacing is ever changed for one of the two constants (`sessionRowHeight` / the grid's `spacing`), a 5-session island keeps `canScroll == true`, the native self-check overrides `scrollDisabled(false)`, and the bottom row becomes unreachable with no indicator and no 「上下滑动查看更多」 hint removed — the failure is silent because the count-based readout still says it can scroll.
fix: Measure the need instead of predicting it: compare the grid's ideal height (`sessions.count` rows) against the lane in the same expression that sets `scrollDisabled`, or drive both `canScroll` and the hint from one `@State` set by the grid's own `onGeometryChange(ideal height)`.

summary: The alert strip reads `session.waitingReason` (empty-aware) in one arm but re-spells the literal 「等待你确认」 in the other, so a reason-less parked session flips its verb depending on which arm renders.
evidence: NotchIslandView.swift:526-537: `.needsInput` → `who + " · " + (session.waitingReason.isEmpty ? "等待你确认" : session.waitingReason)`, while `.finished` → `who + " · 等待你的下一步"` and the session-row subtitle (IslandComponents.swift:240-242) uses `session.waitingReason.isEmpty ? "等待你确认" : session.waitingReason`. The strip is reached both through `model.needsInput` (edge) and through `model.finished`, and `IslandLiveModel.flatten` leaves `waitingReason` empty for Codex (`waitingReason: s.isWaiting ? "等待你确认" : ""`, IslandLiveModel.swift:348) and non-empty for Claude/Cursor.
failure: A SessionInfo carrying `status == .waiting` but no `pendingTool` (the fall-through arm in SessionMonitor.swift:131-139) produces `waitingReason == "等待你确认"` and is fine; but any future reason-less park (a new CLI status string, a fixture-built session) prints a bare 「等待你确认」 in the strip while the session row beside it prints the same thing — the two surfaces cannot disagree today only because both defaults happen to be equal, and nothing pins that.
fix: Hoist the empty-aware line into one computed property on `IslandSession` (e.g. `waitingLine`) and use it from the row and both alert arms, so the default lives in one place.
verdict_note: Fixed 2026-10-07: IslandSessionRow.waitingLine(for:) is a shared static; the alert strip’s needsInput detail reads it, so the empty-aware fallback word lives in one place.

summary: The panel's height is derived from a hard-coded `tallestNotch: CGFloat = 46` that shadows the real notch height the same panel is positioned against, and the comment claims a derivation it does not perform.
evidence: NotchIslandView.swift:51-58 `static var panelSize: CGSize { CGSize(width: panelWidth, height: expandedMaxHeight + 48) }` with `private static var expandedMaxHeight: CGFloat { let tallestNotch: CGFloat = 46; return tallestNotch + contentTopGap + expandedLaneHeight + sectionGap + usageCardHeight + bottomPadding }`, versus `NotchIslandState.expandedSize` (NotchIslandController.swift:45-49) which uses the live `state.notch.height`. docs/design/10-notch-island.md:127 documents the constant as “由展开态最高几何推出：刘海 46 … 不是手填数字”.
failure: On a display whose safe-area notch exceeds 46pt (a future hardware revision, or an external display reporting a tall auxiliary top area through NotchGeometry's pseudo path), the expanded island's real height (`notch.height + …`) exceeds `panelSize.height - 48`, so the bottom of the usage card is clipped by the fixed hosting frame while every static check still passes — the failure is geometric and invisible in any current test.
fix: Make the panel height follow the geometry it is positioned against (take `notch.height` as a parameter when the panel is installed, or size the capsule generously from the ratio the other constants already use) rather than pinning `46`.
recheck_note: Deferred: the tallestNotch constant is a layout reservation independent of the runtime notch height; aligning it with the controller’s live measurement needs the panel-geometry work, tracked as open.

summary: The strip's session-count readout rolls by default although the only figure the strip ever shows is a count that just changed — every sessions publish buys a display cycle for a roll nobody asked for, on the one surface whose cost model is the documented reason other figures opt out.
evidence: NotchIslandView.swift:381-383 `RollingNumberText("\(sessions.count) 个会话")` (no `rolls:` argument, default `true`); contrast the collapsed wing's figure which passes `rolls: false` explicitly (NotchIslandView.swift:219) with the measured rationale in Interaction.swift:425-445 (“a surface nobody is looking at … the collapsed readout”), and the card's month line which passes figures the sampler feeds. `IslandLiveModel.apply` sets `sessions` only when the flattened array changes (removeDuplicates, IslandLiveModel.swift:169-171).
failure: Every session start/finish (and each poll that changes any session's activity string, since `IslandSession.activity` rides the same array) opens one animated transaction on the island panel; measured cost of the class is a full hosting-view layout per display cycle while the roll is in flight (docs/reviews/performance-measurements.md:20). The roll is invisible during the same update anyway because the island is usually in a non-visible window.
fix: `RollingNumberText("\(sessions.count) 个会话", rolls: false)` — the count still updates; the strip stops being a per-poll display-cycle source.
verdict_note: Fixed 2026-10-07: the island lane footer count uses RollingNumberText(..., rolls: false) — an aggregate count does not roll.

summary: The UIWakePolicy.changes observer writes surfaceVisible unconditionally; the island's hover expand/collapse publishes on every pointer entry/exit, so each such transition re-evaluates the main window shell and its whole detail tree even when only the island changed (no equality guard).
evidence: MainWindowView.swift:60 `@State private var surfaceVisible = UIWakePolicy.hasVisibleMainWindow`, :82-83 `.environment(\.surfaceIsVisible, surfaceVisible).onReceive(UIWakePolicy.changes) { surfaceVisible = UIWakePolicy.hasVisibleMainWindow }`. Writers: UIWakePolicy.swift:64-70 `setIslandExpanded` sends on change; NotchIslandController.swift:398-407 expand() / :520-542 collapse() with `if wasExpanded { UIWakePolicy.setIslandExpanded(false) }`, driven by hover per the state diagram at :67 ("collapsed --hover 120 ms--> expanded --pointer away 250 ms--> collapsed"). An unchanged SwiftUI state write still invalidates.
failure: Moving the pointer over the notch island a few times with the main window open publishes several transitions; each re-writes the unchanged Bool, so the active page (and every `surfaceIsVisible` consumer: RollingNumberModifier, ResourceMonitorScope, HardwareIllustration) re-evaluates for a value that did not move - the equal-value-invalidation shape the codebase guards against elsewhere (e.g. HoverState at Interaction.swift:147-150).
fix: Guard the write: `let visible = UIWakePolicy.hasVisibleMainWindow; if visible != surfaceVisible { surfaceVisible = visible }`.

summary: The ⌘K palette's per-entity results lose their payloads at the routing layer: `.session` discards its pid and `.provider` discards its id, so selecting a specific session/provider opens a generic page; no test covers either branch and the enum payloads exist only to be dropped.
evidence: MainWindowView.swift:130-139 `case .session: navigate(to: .sessions)` and `case .provider: providerStore.requestNavigation(.editor(.providers))` - neither reads the associated value. CommandPalette.swift:11-12 `case session(pid: Int)` / `case provider(id: UUID)`, built at :222-227 (`.session(pid: s.pid)`) and :243-249 (`.provider(id: p.id)`). `grep -rn CommandResult Tests Tools` finds only the fixture stub at Tests/remaining-performance-regressions.py:67 `enum CommandResult { case fixture }`.
failure: User types a session name in ⌘K and presses Return: the app lands on 会话 with no indication of which session was chosen although the palette advertised a per-session row; same for the provider id.
fix: Either make the cases payload-free or route the pid/id into the destination page's selection; add a source-slice regression asserting the switch consumes the payloads.
verdict_note: Fixed 2026-10-07: CommandResult.session and .provider are payload-free — the routing switch cannot silently drop a payload that no destination consumes, and there is no unchecked pid conversion. (The alternative, adding per-row selection to the pages, would be new routing behaviour, not a fix to the drop.)

summary: The action bar reads ProcessSampler.shared.host directly in the shell body, making the popup shell a reader of the 1 Hz host snapshot: every accepted sample whose host value differs re-evaluates the whole shell (header, both panels, action bar) for a flag that changes only on plug/unplug.
evidence: MenuBarView.swift:141-145 `private var actionBar: some View { IconChipRow(spacing: Theme.Space.s2) { if ProcessSampler.shared.host.batteryInstalled { CompactBatteryChargeControl() } ... } }`. ProcessSampler.swift:18-20 `@Observable final class ProcessSampler`, :205 `var host = HostStats()`, publish at :577-616 `if self.host != host { self.host = host }` on every tick; applyPeriod (:367-394) sets 1 s (live) / 2 s cadence while a resource surface is open.
failure: With the popup open (a resource scope, MachineKpiStrip.swift:44-48) one host change per second re-runs MenuBarView's body, re-evaluating PanelHeader, SessionsPanelView and UsagePanel per tick instead of per power event - exactly the invalidation scope the file's own comments (:35-40, :103-115) were written to avoid.
fix: Read the flag in a tiny leaf view (same pattern as `MainWindowSessionStatus`) so only that subtree invalidates, or expose `batteryInstalled` as its own observable property on ProcessSampler.
verdict_note: Fixed 2026-10-07: MenuBarBatteryChip leaf view reads ProcessSampler.shared.host.batteryInstalled in its own body (same split as FeedbackToastHost / MainWindowSessionStatus), so 1 Hz host publishes invalidate only the chip, not the whole popup shell.

evidence: 第 99–105 行 `ForEach(store.drafts.values.sorted { $0.id < $1.id })`；`drafts` 每次 `updateDraft` 都整体赋值（FeishuDocumentStore.swift:549 `drafts[id] = draft`），即每敲一个字符 draftToolbar/header 路径都可能重跑到这里。上限 8 条（reserveDraft），所以是 < 30 次比较/字符的浪费，量级小但纯白给。

evidence: 第 48 行 `.onChange(of: store.activeDraftID) { _, _ in draftPreview = true; ... }` 不区分「切换草稿」与「保存完成」；FeishuDocumentStore.swift:559-563 保存成功时执行 `drafts.removeValue(forKey: draft.id)` 且 `activeDraftID = nil`，id 变化于是触发重置。用户存盘后视图从源码编辑器跳回 `reader(draft.text)`（第 376 行）。同理 `discardDraft()` 也触发。

evidence: 第 590–611 行：`timestamp`（withInternetDateTime+fractionalSeconds）+ `timestampSeconds`（无选项）双 formatter，另有 `Double(value)` 数字 epoch 分支、`>10_000_000_000` 毫秒判定、`Calendar.current.isDateInToday` → 「今天 HH:mm」，否则 month/day。UsageIndex.swift:1343-1356 的 `isoFormatter`/`isoFormatterNoFrac`/`isoDate` 是同一模式但不含数字分支、不含「今天」渲染。两处都各自 new 两个静态 formatter，且 `FeishuDocumentRow.kind(type)` 对 type 的映射（594–604 行）与 FeishuDocument.symbol（FeishuDocumentStore.swift:22-31）也是两份 type 表。
failure: 同一 ISO 字符串在飞书列表与 usage 页显示不同结果（一处接受无小数秒，两处的回退顺序不同），且 4 个静态 formatter 重复存两份实现；以后统一修 ISO 解析需要改多处。

summary: 延迟 reconcile 用 loadGen 做守卫，而 reloadDetail 每次选中/详情重载也 loadGen++，同一发布回合内的列表修正可能被误丢
evidence: 359-367: `.onReceive(catalog.$records) { _ in let generation = state.loadGen; DispatchQueue.main.async { guard state.mounted, generation == state.loadGen else { return }; reconcileFilteredRecords() } }`；1000-1001 reloadDetail 一进来就 state.loadGen += 1。loadGen 同时表达「挂载世代」和「加载世代」：只要在本发布与延迟块执行之间发生过任意一次详情加载（如同回合里选中行 finish 触发 368-372 行 onChange(of: currentSummary?.state) → reloadDetail），本条发布的 reconcile 就被丢弃——包括「剪除后重设 selectedID」与「值副本刷新」。frame-work 回归只模拟 unmount 后 loadGen++，不覆盖这一交互。
failure: 若 onReceive 排入的 main.async 块被排空之前发生 reloadDetail：a) 选中行被剪除时这次发布的修正被丢弃，列表无高亮且详情落到 filtered.first；b) 刚 finish 的选中行在 filteredCache 保持 streaming 旧副本，实时角标与停止按钮不消失，直到下一次抓包发布。不确定点：静态无法确认 SwiftUI 更新回合与 main.async 块的先后（runloop 观察者顺序），故 confidence low。
fix: 给挂载周期单独的 token（仅 onAppear/onDisappear 增删），延迟 reconcile 只校验该 token 与 state.mounted，不再复用会被 reloadDetail 推进的 loadGen。

summary: 大文本气泡每次渲染都重新 `count` 并 `split` 出整行数组，只为估高度，数组随即被丢弃
evidence: Lines 893-899：`if text.count > 8_000 { let lines = max(16, text.split(separator: "\n", omittingEmptySubsequences: false).count) ... }` —— count 是 O(n)、split 会为每一行分配 Substring 并构造数组。
failure: 流式期间每 100 ms ConversationBuilder 完成一次并替换 displayBlocks → 可见气泡全部重绘：一个 60 KB / 900 行的回答每次重建都扫描全文并分配约 900 个 Substring（~14 KB 垃圾），10 Hz 下约 140 KB/s 的短命分配与重复扫描；全模式（full）下每个 system/工具气泡同样代价。
fix: 单遍计数不建数组：`var lines = 1; for b in text.utf8 where b == 10 { lines += 1 }; lines = max(16, lines)`；或把行数估好放进 ConvBlock 让渲染只读。
verdict_note: The 8 KB branch threshold now reads utf8.count (O(1)); the line split stays, it feeds the height estimate the PlainDumpView frame uses.

summary: 「复制」在主线程序列化并美化最长 16 MB JSON（完整 parse + pretty 重排 + 全文替换）
evidence: Lines 848-855：`NSPasteboard.general.setString(JSONTree.pretty(src), forType: .string)`，而 JSONTree.pretty（JSONTreeView.swift:69-75）做 `JSONSerialization.jsonObject` + `.prettyPrinted` 重序列化 + 对整个输出 `replacingOccurrences(of: "\\/", with: "/")`，全部同步。

summary: ConversationInput 的合成 Equatable 按声明顺序先比较 history（可达上万 Turn），而后才轮到真正会变的 live；流式期间每 100 ms 的一次去重因而是对整段历史的全量比较
evidence: Lines 1184-1193 成员顺序为 id, history, live, response, headers, full, streaming, query；去重在 TrafficPageState.requestConversation（line 61）`guard conversationInput != input else { return }`。流式 flush 每次都会重建 input 并进入这个比较。
failure: 长会话（几百 turn、数百 KB 到数 MB 文本）流式时，每 100 ms 的相等性检查在发现 live 不同之前先逐元素比较整个 history（full 模式下还包括最长 16 MB 的 response 字符串），最坏情况下是主线程上每秒数十 MB 的逐字节比较；若 Swift String == 未命中同存储快路径则是真实浪费，命中则接近零——无法静态确定，故置信度 medium。

verdict_note: Probe-verified: Array equality short-circuits on shared storage (0.000 ms for 10k shared Turns), and every construction site reuses the turn array's storage, so a 100 ms flush compares only the live fields. No reordering needed.

[]`（L455-458），而 `manager.groups` 每次 /proxies 刷新都是新数组（VpnManager.swift:914-915 以整体替换发布）。

summary: VPNView 自己也观察 VpnManager（L6），但 `refreshIP()` 已经由 VpnManager.waitUntilReady()（VpnManager.swift:838）在每次内核就绪时调用；两条路径都在 isRunning 变为 true 时打到最多 7 个出口 IP 端点。
evidence: L135-138: `.onChange(of: manager.isRunning) { _, on in if on { Task { await VpnNetProbe.shared.refreshIP() } } … }`；VpnManager.swift:822-839 `waitUntilReady()` 在 `/version` 应答后 `state = .running` 并 `Task { await VpnNetProbe.shared.refreshIP() }`。`refreshIP` 有单飞守卫（VpnNetProbe.swift:99 `guard ipLookup == nil`），所以第二次调用被丢弃 —— 真正被绕过的是「谁先到」的不确定性：若 UI 侧的 onChange 先命中，manager 侧那次（含 `afterNodeSwitch` 之外的重试逻辑）不会运行。
failure: 网络稍慢时，UI 的 onChange 先发起一次未做「隧道已稳定」等待的查找：它拿到的是旧出口或直接失败，随后页面显示「无法取得出口 IP」且 12 s 内没有人再发起新查找（单飞守卫把它挡住），直到用户手动点出口 IP 按钮。
fix: 删除 L135-138 的 UI 侧触发（保留 `else { reset() }`），把 IP 刷新完全交给 VpnManager 的就绪路径；或在 probe 上暴露一个带 generation 的 queued 重试，让后到的调用者在当前查找结束后补发一次而非被丢弃。
verdict_note: Fixed 2026-10-07: the UI-side refreshIP trigger is deleted (only the reset stays); VpnManager.waitUntilReady (line 891) remains the single kick-off on core readiness, so the two no longer race into the single-flight guard and silently drop one.

symbol: VpnDomainQuery.pageRange vs 页脚页码表达式
summary: 同一页码公式在 VpnDomainQuery.pageRange 与 section 的页脚各写一份，且 clamp 规则已漂移：pageRange 把 page 上限夹到 `(count-1)/pageSize`，页脚只用 `min(page, …)` 显示、`page` 本身不被夹到 0。
evidence: VpnDomainQuery.swift:9-18 `let page = min(max(0, page), (count - 1) / pageSize)`；VpnDomainLogSection.swift:283-294 页脚按钮直接读写 `page`，L288 显示 `min(page, max(0, (visibleCount - 1) / VpnDomainQuery.pageSize)) + 1 / …`，L290-293 的「更新」只做 `page = max(0, page - 1)`，从不写回 `pageRange` 的夹紧结果。
failure: detail 模式下翻到末页后日志被清空（或筛选使 visibleCount 变小），`page` 仍保留大值：L287 的「更早」保持可用（判断依据是 `pageRange.lowerBound == 0`，而 pageRange 内部已夹紧为 0..<200），按钮点下去 `page += 1` 却没任何视觉变化；L494 的 `ForEach(visibleStats[pageRange])` 与新的夹紧值之间的分页状态并不一致，用户看到页脚数字与内容页对不上。
fix: 把页脚的两处 `page` 读写也走 `VpnDomainQuery.pageRange(count:visibleCount, page:page, newestFirst:…)` 的夹紧结果，或抽一个 `clampedPage` 计算属性同时供页脚与 `pageRange` 使用。

summary: The eye button toggles `editing`, which *swaps a TextField for a Text* — the reveal never shows the key, it just enters edit mode where the field is a plain (unmasked) `TextField`; combined with the click-target being the card-sized well, the affordance costs a full focus/defocus round trip per use.
evidence: Lines 25-33: editing shows `TextField(placeholder, text: $text)` — plaintext (the file's own doc at :3-4 explains it must not be a SecureField). Lines 50-54: the eye button does `editing.toggle(); focused = editing`. Lines 56-57: `onChange(of: focused) { if !value { editing = false } }` + `onChange(of: editing) { if value { focused = true } }` — two watchers that re-enter each other (editing true → focused true → no-op; focused false → editing false → no-op), so the steady state is consistent, but the reveal is not a reveal: `restText` (:18-21) always returns the dot run when text is non-empty, and the only way to see the stored key is to be *editing* it.
failure: A user wanting to verify a pasted key clicks the eye, gets a focused editable field (correct), but a second click on the eye while focused writes `editing=false` then `focused=false` in the same update (line 51-52 + 56) — the field collapses and the key is masked again immediately, so 'show' from the *edit* state behaves as 'hide' with a focus change. Not a crash; a control whose two labels disagree with what it does.
fix: Decide what the eye means and make the label match: either drop it (the well is already a button that enters edit — :34-49) or make it a true reveal that keeps `editing` and only flips a `revealed` flag: `Text(revealed ? text : "••••…")` in the non-editing branch. Two lines either way.
verdict_note: Re-verified 2026-10-07: toggling `editing` is the documented design — plaintext only while editing, masked at rest — and the eye label matches the toggle state.

summary: `strip(count:width:maxRows:compact:)` returns `visible` and `height`, but `height` is sized against the *estimated* width while its only caller draws `visible` cards; when the real box is narrower than the estimate the drawn grid packs the prefix into more rows than the reserved height, and the difference is taken out of the caller's own content.
evidence: Lines 214-228: `let overflow = count > capacity`, `let visible = overflow ? max(0, capacity - 1) : max(0, count)`, `let drawn = visible + (overflow ? 1 : 0)`, `rows = max(1, Int(ceil(Double(drawn) / Double(columns))))`. SessionsView.swift:937 `stripWidthEstimate = 300` and :944-945 `strip = SwarmGrid.strip(count: .max, width: stripWidthEstimate, maxRows: stripRows, compact: true)`, then :1036 draws `Array(agents.prefix(Self.strip.visible))` inside `.frame(height: Self.strip.height)`. `columns(forWidth: 300, compact: true)` = Int((300+3)/(56+3)) = 5 → capacity 10, visible 9, drawn 10, rows 2 → height 2*24+3 = 51. With `.max` count the strip *always* reports overflow, so `visible` is always capacity-1 — the code path that assumes '"+N" never hidden' (comment at :219-221) is dead when the real count ≤ 9 but the badge above is drawn from `agents.count` (SessionsView.swift:959 `StatusPill(label: "⋯\(agents.count)"`) — the strip shows '+N' whenever the actual count exceeds 9, correct, but the numbering reported by the popover head at :970 (`agents.count 个子 agent`) and the strip's own `+N` can disagree because the strip's `overflow` is a function of `.max`, not of the real count.
failure: A grid card narrower than 300 pt (three columns at a 1120 pt window → ~355 pt cell; but the *popup* card ExternalSessionCardView draws its own swarm at 360x260 and never uses `strip`, so the exposure is the page's grid card only): when the cell is under 300 pt, `columns(forWidth: 300)` = 5 but the drawn box fits only 4, so 9 agents are drawn in ceil(9/4) = 3 rows inside a 51 pt frame → the bottom row is clipped, and the ⋯N badge (fed by `agents.count`) no longer matches what is visible.
fix: Size the strip against the box it is actually drawn in. Either pass the measured width (GeometryReader) or have the caller clamp what it draws: `Array(agents.prefix(min(Self.strip.visible, columns(forWidth: actualWidth) * stripRows)))`. Cheapest: make `visible` a function of the drawn box and cache per width, the way `EqualRowGrid.Cache` already does (Tile.swift:383-396).
verdict_note: Already fixed in 5b4ebb0: strip width is measured via onGeometryChange (SessionsView.swift:943/1050), and Tests/swarm-grid-regressions.py pins strip height against the drawn box.

summary: The `children.isEmpty` branch is documented as unreachable ('The callers skip this view entirely when there is nothing to show') and every call site does skip it, so the branch plus its comment is defensive code that can never be exercised.
evidence: Lines 34-37 `if children.isEmpty { Color.clear } else { … }` with the comment at :35-36 confirming the callers skip it. All four call sites gate: ExternalSessionCardView.swift:100 draws the swarm only inside the `descendantCount > 0` popover; SessionsView.swift:1035 is wrapped in `if !agents.isEmpty` (:1033); SessionsView.swift:1063 is inside the popover built only when `!agents.isEmpty` (:952); SessionsView.swift:842 is in the `tree.count == 1` branch whose node by construction has children (the tile is only chosen when `agents.count > 0` per :771). No caller can pass `[]` and still mount the view.
failure: None at runtime — this is a maintenance cost: the empty branch is the first thing a reader sees, it cannot be covered by a test (no caller can reach it), and its `Color.clear` would silently occupy the caller's frame if someone ever routed an empty list here. Low severity by design; reported because the review asks to distinguish 'reachable defensive' from 'never reached'.
fix: Either delete the branch (`var body: some View { … }` with the GeometryReader as the body) and keep the note, or keep it but say 'unreachable today — a caller that mounts an empty cluster would still be legal', so the next reader does not treat it as a live path.
verdict_note: Code: the `children.isEmpty` early branch is gone; the comment above `body` records that callers gate on fan-out and that empty input packs to zero rows. The `SwarmGrid` zero-count branch keeps the type total.

summary: `ForEach(0..<grid.rows, id: \.self)` with a per-pass `rowCells` array: the identity is positional, so a count change (an agent finishing and leaving the tree) re-identifies every cell by index rather than by agent, and SwiftUI cannot preserve the untouched cards across a poll that adds/removes one child.
evidence: Lines 45-50: `ForEach(0..<grid.rows, id: \.self) { row in HStack { ForEach(rowCells(row, grid: grid, shown: shown), id: \.index) { cell in tile(cell.item, grid: grid) } … } }` and `rowCells` builds fresh tuples (`out.append((index, children[index]))`, lines 73-85). The index is `row * grid.columns + column`, i.e. a cell's identity is its *position*, not the agent's `id` — while `children` is 'most recently touched first' (:27-28), so a single write to an idle child reorders the array and every downstream cell's identity shifts. The codebase's own `ForEach` usage elsewhere keys on model ids precisely to avoid this.
failure: When agents are sorted by recency and one becomes active, the array order changes: all cards after it get new identities, so their `RollingNumberText` transitions and `onHover` regions are torn down and rebuilt rather than diffed. Reordering an N-card grid costs N cell reconstructions instead of one moved cell. Bounded (24-38 pt cards, no shadows on this surface) and no user-visible glitch is documented — hence low confidence.
fix: Key the row ForEach on a stable value — the row's first child id (`ForEach(grid.rowStarts, id: \.self)`) or flatten to one `ForEach(0..<shown, id: \.self)` over an index that the *children array order* does not perturb. The minimal change that keeps the current look: `id: \.index` → `id: \.item?.id` on the inner ForEach (the overflow tile's synthetic id can be `"overflow"`), so a card keeps its identity across a reorder.
verdict_note: Code: rows and cells now carry the agents' own ids (`Row`/`Cell` `Identifiable` structs; the overflow tile is the stable "overflow" id), so a poll that adds or drops one child preserves every surviving card's identity instead of re-keying the grid by index. Cells are built from `SwarmGrid.slots()`, the same placement the new arithmetic test drives.

summary: The header renders 『目标 \(Int(controller.threshold))%』 with `Int(...)` on a `Double` that comes from a slider/text path and a `didSet` clamp — safe today, but the same screen's second read at :61 uses the identical conversion and the model's `didSet` writes `threshold` *while reading it*, so a NaN reaching the setter traps in `Int(Double.nan)`.
evidence: BatteryChargeController.swift:72-78: `var threshold: Double { didSet { let value = min(100, max(Self.minLimit, threshold.rounded())); if threshold != value { threshold = value }; UserDefaults.standard.set(Int(value), forKey: "batteryChargeLimit") } }` — `Int(value)` and `Int(Self.minLimit)` are unchecked conversions. `setLimit(_:)` (line 210-211) is fed from the Slider binding at BatteryChargeControls.swift:57 (`controller.setLimit(Int($0))`) — `Int($0)` on a slider's `Double` is likewise unchecked, and `Slider` with `in: 20...100` cannot produce NaN, but `threshold` is also loaded from `UserDefaults` at :98-99 (`object(forKey:) as? Int ?? 80`) which is a safe read. The view's own `Int(controller.threshold)` at :17 and :61 is then checked only by construction. So the *trap* is unreachable today — but the guards are three separate implicit ones (`Slider` bounds, `as? Int`, `?? 80`) rather than one at the boundary, and this is 8万行 app whose numbers elsewhere go through `Int(...)` conversions that have trapped before (the repo's own rules call out 『整数溢出与 Int 转换 trap』).
failure: Any future writer of `threshold` (a preset button, a restored JSON value, a test fixture that sets 20.5) that lands a value outside `[minLimit, 100]` re-enters `didSet` with a value that is *not* re-clamped in the same pass (`max(Self.minLimit, threshold.rounded())` clamps the low end but `min(100, …)` the top — both are total, so it terminates), and `Int(value)` on a finite value is fine; the trap needs NaN, which only arrives from a division or a parsed string. Low confidence because no current path produces it.
fix: Nothing in this file needs changing for correctness today; the one-line hardening is at the model boundary, not the view: `let value = threshold.isFinite ? min(100, max(Self.minLimit, threshold.rounded())) : Self.minLimit`. Report only because the review asks for Int-conversion traps and this is the file's only one.
verdict_note: Re-verified 2026-10-07: no current writer can yield NaN — the Slider is 20...100 and UserDefaults reads `as? Int`; the didSet rounds and clamps finite values.

summary: The selected-mode rendering builds `RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12).fill(...)` plus a second stroked `RoundedRectangle` *inside* the Button label, bypassing the app's `TileSurface`/`InstrumentWell` vocabulary; two shapes with a `.continuous` style and a hard-coded 12 (equal to `Theme.Radius.md`, so not a drift) per mode button — four buttons × 2 shapes rebuilt on every controller publish.
evidence: Lines 96-103: `.background(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12, style: .continuous).fill(selected ? Theme.chartBlue.opacity(0.14) : Theme.bgOverlay))` and `.overlay(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12, style: .continuous).strokeBorder(selected ? … : Color.clear, lineWidth: 1))`. The battery controller publishes on its 2 s helper heartbeat (batteryctl.c:207-214 reports every 2 s and BatteryChargeController.receive writes `mode`/`state`/`appliedLimit` each time, :379-381), so `modeButton` re-runs for all four modes at 0.5 Hz while the controls are on screen. The card-shadow audit (Tile.swift:126-149) established that per-card fill+stroke pairs are the app's compositing unit and moved them to layer-based shadows; here the pair is 4 small buttons so the absolute cost is small.
failure: Four mode buttons repaint their plates twice per second for a selection that changes on user action only. It is the same class of waste the `@ProviderState` field-scoping work removed elsewhere, at a much smaller scale; reported as low because the popover/card is only mounted while visible.
fix: Hoist the two shapes into `.background(selected ? AnyShapeStyle(...) : AnyShapeStyle(Theme.bgOverlay))` on a single `RoundedRectangle`, or key the whole label on `Equatable` selected state so the 2 s publishes that do not change `mode`/`pending`/`supported` do not rebuild it. The `selected` expression at :82-83 is cheap; the redraw is the cost.
verdict_note: Fixed 2026-10-07: the mode button face moved into ModeButtonFace, an Equatable view comparing only (mode, selected), so the ~2 s controller publishes that change neither skip it; the double hand-drawn 12-radius RoundedRectangle pair became one plate whose corner is Theme.Radius.md.

summary: @Bindable on a @MainActor @Observable singleton is correct and safe, but the view body reads ~14 observed properties (`pending`, `probing`, `authorizingHelper`, `threshold`, `supported`, `probeError`, `dischargeSupported`, `notice`, `measuredText`, `lastError`, `mode`, `recoveryUnconfirmed`, `processIsRunning`, `savedMode`, `limitConfirmed`, `isRestoring`, `managesLimit`) — all observation-tracked, so *any* one of the controller's ~30 properties changing re-runs the whole body, including the two `Text`, four buttons, slider and 5 caption strings.
evidence: BatteryChargeControls.swift:5 `@Bindable private var controller = BatteryChargeController.shared`; the body reads at :14, :17, :20, :23, :24, :26, :30, :33, :35, :39, :42, :48-49, plus `limitSlider` (:57, :65, :72-78) and `modeButton` (:82-83, :106-108). `receive` (BatteryChargeController.swift:352-405) writes `lastResponseAt`, `sleeping`, `dischargeSupported`, `lastError`, `state`, `mode`, `appliedLimit`, `notice`, `recoveryUnconfirmed`, `measuredText` on each 2 s helper report — and the helper reports unconditionally every 2 s (batteryctl.c:207-214), including `mode`/`appliedLimit` writes that are usually identical values (`@Observable` does not dedupe assignments; only `if state != status.state` at :378 has an explicit guard).
failure: While the battery panel is open, the entire controls subtree re-evaluates every 2 s regardless of whether anything it draws changed, and this view is embedded in the dashboard's energy card (PowerFlowCard.swift:171) — the page the perf docs treat as the hot surface. Cupertino-scale cost, not a leak; the concrete waste is the 4-mode ForEach structure rebuilt per tick.
fix: Two cheap moves: (a) guard the identical writes in `receive` (`if appliedLimit != status.limit { appliedLimit = status.limit }`, same for `mode`/`notice`/`dischargeSupported`) so a steady-state report publishes nothing; or (b) split the static chrome (slider labels, captions) out of the observed subtree. (a) is the smaller change and matches the file's own `if state != status.state` precedent at :378.
verdict_note: Fixed 2026-10-07: the ~2 s status receive now guards every published assignment (dischargeSupported, lastError, mode, state, appliedLimit, sleeping, notice, recoveryUnconfirmed) with an inequality test, so a status echo that changes nothing no longer invalidates every observing surface.

summary: `NSImage(named: "AppIcon")` re-looks-up the app icon through AppKit's named-image tables on every body evaluation, and silently falls back to `NSApp.applicationIconImage` — a fallback that can be the *generic* document icon when the process has no bundle (a slice test, the preview harness).
evidence: BrandMark.swift:17-20 `private static var appIcon: NSImage { if let named = NSImage(named: "AppIcon") { return named }; return NSApp.applicationIconImage }` with no cache. The bundle does carry a resolvable icon — verified against the built dev bundle: `Bundle(path: .build/dev/'ClaudeBar Dev.app').image(forResource: "AppIcon")` → true, and `paths(forResourcesOfType: "icns")` → `Contents/Resources/AppIcon.icns` (build.sh:147-152 copies it; `CFBundleIconFile` = AppIcon at build.sh:338-339) — so the named lookup succeeds in the shipped app, and the fallback is what the test/preview slices see. The sibling type solves exactly this with a cache: ProductBrandMark.swift:203 `private static let cache = NSCache<NSString, NSImage>()` with the comment '`NSImage(contentsOf:)` reads and decodes a PNG on every call'.
failure: Every `brand` render (MainWindowView.swift:217 `BrandMark(size: 24)`, re-evaluated on each top-bar pass) performs a bundle lookup in the named-image registry; and in a slice/render harness (the repo has several that host `MainWindowView`-adjacent views) the missing bundle makes the header draw AppKit's generic application icon instead of the product mark — a silent wrong-image, not a blank, which is the failure mode product-mark-regressions.py was written to catch for `ProductBrandMark` but does not cover for `BrandMark` (`grep BrandMark Tests/` → only widget/preview mentions).
fix: One line: `private static let appIcon: NSImage = NSImage(named: "AppIcon") ?? NSApp.applicationIconImage` (a `static let` is lazy and cached per process). If the harness case matters, prefer `NSImage(contentsOf: Bundle.main.url(forResource: "AppIcon", withExtension: "icns"))` and keep the `applicationIconImage` fallback — that is the same file the Dock uses, so it cannot drift.
verdict_note: Fixed 2026-10-07: BrandMark.appIcon is now a static let — the bundle lookup (and the generic-icon fallback) resolves once per process instead of per body render; ProductBrandMark already cached the same lookup.

summary: `CursorMark` re-specifies the mark's size and shadow that `CodexModelMark.mark(side:)` exists to own, so the two can drift exactly the way this file's header says callers' copies used to.
evidence: This file's own rationale (lines 13-15): "It is a view rather than a bare `Image` because it owns the mark's size and shadow - the two things every caller had to remember and one of them always got wrong." `CodexModelMark.mark` (37-41): `ProductBrandMark(codex: codex, well: false).frame(width: side, height: side).shadow(color: .black.opacity(codex ? 0.16 : 0.22), radius: 5, y: 2)`; `CursorMark.body` (52-57): `ProductBrandMark(brand: .cursor, well: false).frame(width: 13, height: 13).shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.2), radius: 5, y: 2)` - a hand-copied radius/y/opacity and a hardcoded 13 next to `CodexModelMark`'s `mark(side: 13)` call in PanelHeader.swift:39/49.
failure: The next retune of the chip mark (a 14pt mark, a softer shadow, a reduce-motion or page-dependent shadow) lands in `CodexModelMark.mark` and misses `CursorMark`; the Cursor chip then renders at a different size/shadow from the CC and Codex chips sitting in the same `EqualRowGrid` row - the mismatch class the file was written to prevent.
fix: Give both marks one builder: e.g. a `private func mark(_ brand: ProductBrandMark.Brand, side: CGFloat)` in this file (or on `ProductBrandMark`) that owns frame + shadow, and have `CursorMark` call it with `.cursor`.
verdict_note: Fixed 2026-10-07: both header-chip marks now build through one MarkBuilder.mark(_:shadowOpacity:side:) in CodexModelMark.swift — the 13pt side, radius 5 and y 2 are declared once, and only the per-family shadow opacity differs. CursorMark no longer re-specifies the frame/shadow pair.

summary: The zero-width `GeometryReader` fallback is unreachable from the app (the only host always supplies a measured width) and is unpinned by tests, while the production host really does pass 0 on its first layout pass.
evidence: Lines 63-74: `if width > 0 { row(in: width) } else { GeometryReader { geo in row(in: geo.size.width) ... }.frame(height: Self.height) }` - the outer `.frame(height:)` clamps the reader while `row(in:)` itself applies `.frame(width: available, height: Self.height)` (84), so the fallback path also double-specifies the row's height. The only call site passes `width: contentWidth` (PanelHeader.swift:538-546) and `contentWidth` is `@State ... = 0` (PanelHeader.swift:371) until the button's `.onGeometryChange` fires (PanelHeader.swift:445); the doc header (lines 32-33) admits the branch exists for "a preview". No test or fixture references `QuotaSwayGauge` (grep over Tests/ finds only `detail-performance-regressions.py` using `CodexQuotaWindow`), and the popup content is destroyed on close (MenuBarController.hide: 283-285), so the 0-width pass repeats on every popup open.
failure: The fallback can rot silently (nothing exercises it, and its height handling already disagrees with `row(in:)`), and on the first layout pass of every popup open the real caller hands the production path `width: 0`, i.e. `row(in: 0)` renders both cells at a zero-width frame until `onGeometryChange` publishes - a one-frame zero-size compositing of the gauge row before the measured width lands.
fix: Make the fallback and the caller agree: treat `0` as "use the proposed width" inside `row` (drop the extra `.frame(height:)`), and have `HeaderSwitchChip` pass the last measured width or skip the gauge for the pass where `contentWidth == 0` (`if contentWidth > 0`) so the zero-width frame is never rendered.

summary: Return is wired to `fireSelected()` twice - the search field's `.onSubmit` and the ancestor `.onKeyPress(.return)` - and the ancestor claims the key with `.handled` for the whole palette subtree.
evidence: Line 147-152: `TextField(..., text: $query).focused($searchFocused).submitLabel(.go).onSubmit { fireSelected() }`; line 113, on the `VStack` that *contains* that field: `.onKeyPress(.return) { fireSelected(); return .handled }`. `fireSelected` (272-278) calls `select` (267-270), which runs `onSelect(item.result)` then `dismiss()`. The palette's only focused control is the search field (`searchFocused = true` at line 117), so one of the two handlers is either dead or duplicated.
failure: If the ancestor handler also sees the Return (SwiftUI `onKeyPress` handlers are consulted outward from the focused view), one press runs `select` twice: `onSelect` fires twice per Return - for a `.provider` result that is two `requestNavigation(.editor(.providers))` bumps (MainWindowView.swift:137, ProviderStore.swift:196-199) and `route()`/`openRequestedEditor` re-running on the second publish, re-assigning `connectionEdit` (ProvidersView.swift:102-107) after the sheet was already presented. If the field consumes the key first, the ancestor's Return line is dead code for the palette's only focused control.
fix: Keep one path: drop the ancestor `.onKeyPress(.return)` line and let `.onSubmit` fire the selection (the ruler keys can stay on the ancestor), or drop `.onSubmit` and keep the key handler.
verdict_note: Fixed 2026-10-07: the ancestor .onKeyPress(.return) is removed; the search field’s .onSubmit is the single fireSelected path, so one Return can no longer run the activation twice.

summary: `CommandResult.session(pid: Int)` carries a payload nothing reads, and the only conversion of it would be an unchecked `Int32` truncation.
evidence: Built at 222-227 (`result: .session(pid: s.pid)`); the sole consumer switches without binding it: MainWindowView.swift:134-135 `case .session: navigate(to: .sessions)` - the pid is never read anywhere (grep for `CommandResult` returns only CommandPalette.swift plus that one switch). `SessionsView` has no focus/scroll-to-session machinery (grep for focusedPid/scrollTo/ScrollViewReader in SessionsView.swift: no hits), so the payload cannot currently be honoured. `pid` is `Int` (`SessionInfo.pid`), i.e. Int64 on arm64.
failure: The payload is dead weight now, and the moment anyone honours it the obvious spelling (`Int32(s.pid)` for a `posix_spawn`/`NSRunningApplication` call) traps on any pid above `Int32.max` (Darwin pids can wrap into that range), i.e. a crash on the very first ⌘K session pick of that process's life. `CommandResult`'s `Equatable` conformance is likewise load-bearing for nothing (no comparison exists).
fix: Either drop the associated value (`case session`) so no incorrect conversion is available, or store the pid as a `String`/`Int64` and have the consumer guard the conversion.
verdict_note: Fixed 2026-10-07 with 505: the session case carries no pid; construction sites updated (CommandPalette buildItems) and the routing switch simplified. Palette suites pass.

summary: 连接卡 tooltip 把耳机的连接态说了两遍，与面板的同一句式不一致。
evidence: 第 162 行 `lines.append("\(accessory.name) \(accessoryValue(accessory, count: accessoryCount)) · \(accessory.connection.label)")`，而 `accessoryValue` 第 335-339 行已经按 `accessory.connection` 返回 ". · 已连接/未连接/已离开"；`Accessory.Connection.label`（AudioAccessoryMonitor.swift:83-89）又是同样的三个词。HardwareDetailPanel.swift:310 的耳机行只用 `accessoryValue(device, count: 1)`，没有追加 label。

summary: `ConnectInterfaceMark.accessoryCount` 是只写不读的存储属性。
evidence: 第 218 行声明，第 62 行由 `LinkCard` 传入（ResourceStrip.swift:67 的 `audioMonitor.accessories.count`）；结构体 body 215-266 行内没有任何读取：`glyph` 用 `interface`，`label` 只读 `accessory`（第 261 行），`SignalCellRow` 只读 `strength`。第 250-253 行注释提到的"more than one thing to name"对应的 "等 N 台" 逻辑只存在于 `accessoryValue`。

summary: RSSI→0…1 标尺在两处各写一份，唯一的守卫是测试里的一条源码字符串断言。
evidence: 本文件第 310 行 `min(1, max(0, Double(rssi + 100) / 60))`，HardwareDetailPanel.swift:416 `private var position: Double? { rssi.map { min(1, max(0, Double($0 + 100) / 60)) } }`；Tests/connection-panel-regressions.py:96 只断言 `'Double(rssi + 100) / 60' in card`，即只盯着卡片这份。`WiFiBars.fraction` 是 internal，面板完全可以调用它却另写了一份。
failure: 改动面板一侧（例如把 60 改成 55）：回归仍绿，但同一 −70 dBm 在卡片 12 格里亮 7 格、在 popover 30 格标尺上按另一比例定位——正是该测试注释警告的"a tile and its popover disagree about one dBm"。
fix: 面板第 416 行改为 `rssi.map { WiFiBars.fraction(for: $0) }`，删掉第二份公式。

summary: `WiFiBars.label(for:)` 声明返回 `String?` 但没有任何分支返回 nil，三处调用点的兜底分支不可达。
evidence: 第 313-320 行的 switch 是 `..<(-75)` / `..<(-62)` / `..<(-50)` / `default`，穷尽且每支都有值，因此永不返回 nil；而调用方按可空处理：第 100 行 `.map { $0 + " · " } ?? ""`、第 159 行 `?? ""`、HardwareDetailPanel.swift:202 `?? "未知"`。
failure: Optional 语义是假的：任何调用方写 `if let grade = ... else` 或 `??` 的"无读数"分支永远走不到，未来若真有"无读数"需求，现有调用点会静默使用兜底串而不是显示缺失。

summary: `LinkCard.dense` 的 true 分支没有任何调用方可以到达（其 doc 自己承认），是一层废兼容。
evidence: 第 10-14 行注释自述 "Its only caller is the dashboard's `ResourceStrip`, which passes `false` … so the compact spacing this describes is currently unreachable"；`grep -rn "hoverTile(" Sources/` 仅两处调用（ResourceStrip.swift:359 与本文件第 82 行），都传 `dense: false`，`HoverTileModifier`/`TileSurface` 的 dense 另由 `.tile(dense:)` 使用，与本卡无关。
failure: 卡片保留一个无法开启的布局开关：读代码的人会以为 popup 走紧凑密度，实际走的是 `dense == false` 的 `Theme.Radius.lg` + 3pt 内框；未来给卡片加 dense 布局时也没有任何测试能证明它被启用过。

summary: 信号格数的"零读数不亮灯"下界与标尺 clamp 没有任何行为级回归，唯一覆盖是源码字符串断言。
evidence: `grep -rn "WiFiBars\|SignalCellRow" Tests/` 只命中 connection-panel-regressions.py 的注释与第 96 行的 `assert 'Double(rssi + 100) / 60' in card`（字符串存在性，注释里留着同样的式子也能通过）。第 288 行 `let lit = strength > 0.001 ? max(1, Int((strength * Double(Self.count - 1)).rounded()) + 1) : 0` 与第 310 行的 clamp 都没有被编译执行过。

summary: The 'off' connection mark paints a 46pt glyph in Theme.statusIdle — a fill hue the theme documents at 2.92:1 for glyphs — while the same 'idle' meaning elsewhere uses Theme.Ink.idle.
evidence: ConnectionCard.swift:193-199 `switch self { case .attached: return Theme.chartBlue; case .idle: return Theme.textSecondary; case .off: return Theme.statusIdle }`, painted at line 225-228 `Image(systemName: glyph).font(.system(size: 46, weight: .medium)).foregroundColor(state.tint)`. Theme.swift:71-82 reserves `Theme.Ink.*` for 'anything that is *text or a glyph*' and lists `statusIdle` at 2.92:1; the sibling card uses the ink token for the identical state (SessionCardView.swift:34 `Circle().fill(isBusy ? Theme.statusBusy : Theme.Ink.idle)`).
failure: Wi-Fi off (or unassociated radio) → the tile's largest glyph (46pt) is drawn in a grey-hued token measured at 2.92:1 against the white card, i.e. the mark that is supposed to say 'no link' is the faintest object on the tile; on a `Theme.chartBlue` hover wash it drops further.
