批量工具栏每次重建都会把 selectedRecords() 全表扫 4 遍、expandingSkills 全表扫 2 遍，虽然注释宣称「一次决策共享给按钮和读数」
evidence: batchBar (507-517) 依次调用 actionableCount(.disable/.enable/.remove) → batchRecords (438-443) → selectedRecords (422-428, 每次都是 manager.records.filter) + ConnectorBatch.expandingSkills(selected, in: manager.records, ...)（disable/enable 两次）；随后 selectionActionability(581) 再调一次 selectedRecords()。selection 每勾一个 ConnectorTick 就写一次 @State，body 全量重估 → batchBar 重估，一次点击 = 4×manager.records 谓词求值 + 2×inventory 谓词求值 + 3×ConnectorBatch.records 过滤。
failure: 勾选 N 项：当前每 render ≈ (4×records + 2×records) 次谓词求值——page-frontend 夹具规模 records=2000 时约 1.2 万次/帧，真实机器 200 项约 1.2 千次/帧；勾 200 张卡就是 200 次这样的重算。优化后同一 render 只需 1×records（selectedRecords 一次）+ 复用它的 expand/policy 结果，谓词求值降到 1/4 量级（≈2000 次/帧@夹具规模、200 次@真实规模）。
fix: 在 batchBar 里 `let selected = selectedRecords()` 一次，把它作为参数传进一个 `batchRecords(_ action:, from selected:)` 与 `selectionActionability(_ selected:)`；三者共用同一份解析结果，不再各自重扫。

summary: `record.summary.contains("/")` 作为「这是路径」的判据过宽：任何含斜杠的 Skill 描述都会被替换成 scope，卡片丢失描述
evidence: ConnectorsView.swift:906-908：`if let owner = record.sharedOwner { return "由 \(owner) 提供" }; if record.summary.contains("/") { return record.scope }; return record.summary`。而 skillRecord（ConnectorManager.swift:610-623）把 summary 填成 SKILL.md 的 description（metadata.1），如「A/B 测试指南」「and/or 处理」。
failure: 一个描述里带 “/” 的 Skill（例如 `description: Git/GitLab 工作流`）在卡片上显示成「个人」而不是描述——用户看不到它在做什么；反过来说，真正的路径形状判据应为前缀 “/”。
fix: 把判据收紧为 `record.summary.hasPrefix("/")`（MCP/codex 记录的 summary 即 file.path，全部以 “/” 开头），或在模型层显式区分 description 与 path 两个字段。

summary: 批量栏的 .transition(.move+.opacity) 永远不会跑：没有任何动画事务包裹 batchMode 的翻转
evidence: ConnectorsView.swift:573 `.transition(.move(edge: .bottom).combined(with: .opacity))`；触发它的 `toggleBatchMode()`（406-411）只做 `batchMode.toggle()`，整个文件只有一处 `.animation`（785，ConnectorTick 的 selected），没有 `withAnimation`，祖先也没有 `.animation(value: batchMode)`（grep 本文件 + MainWindowView 的 withAnimation 仅在页面切换处）。SwiftUI 只在事务带 animation 时才执行插入/移除过渡。
failure: 点击「批量管理」/「完成管理」时批量栏直接出现/消失，没有 .move 过渡——写在代码里的动效（以及它声称的意图）静默失效；只在恰好与页面切换动画同帧时才偶发地动一下。
fix: 要么在 `toggleBatchMode()` 里包 `withAnimation(reduceMotion ? nil : Theme.Motion.state)`（需补 `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion)`），要么删掉这行 .transition，别留一个不会执行的动效声明。

summary: RemovalRequest 与 BatchConfirm 的 `Identifiable` 与 `let id = UUID()` 完全无人读：两个对话框都走 isPresented 绑定，没有任何 ForEach/.sheet(item:) 消费它们
evidence: ConnectorsView.swift:731-736 与 752-759 都声明 `private struct …: Identifiable { let id = UUID() … }`；全文件对它们的使用只有 `pendingRemoval?.title/.message/.record`（168-177）与 `pendingBatch?.title/.message`（179-189），grep `pendingRemoval?.id|pendingBatch?.id|ForEach(all)` 无命中；唯一 `.sheet(item:)`（164）绑定的是 ConnectorRecord。
failure: 每次 askRemove/askBatch 都白白构造一个 UUID，并且给读者一个错误信号——仿佛这两个值被用作 SwiftUI 身份（例如未来有人改成 `.sheet(item:)` 时会以为已具备身份语义）。
fix: 删掉两处 `: Identifiable` 与 `let id = UUID()`（纯值类型即可，对话框继续用 removalPresented/batchPresented 的 Binding）。

summary: CursorLedger.Row → ModelUsage 的四桶映射在两处逐字重复（缓存写入两处都落到 cacheCreationTokens），任何一侧漏字段都会让同一模型的 token 在卡片与按模型列表里对不上
evidence: CursorTokenUsageCard.swift:26-30 `let stats = ranked.map { ModelUsage(model: $0.model, inputTokens: $0.inputTokens, outputTokens: $0.outputTokens, cacheReadTokens: $0.cacheReadTokens, cacheCreationTokens: $0.cacheWriteTokens) }`；UsageView.swift:83-87 `let cursorStats = request.cursor.values.map { ModelUsage(model: $0.model, inputTokens: $0.inputTokens, outputTokens: $0.outputTokens, cacheReadTokens: $0.cacheReadTokens, cacheCreationTokens: $0.cacheWriteTokens) }`。两处消费同一个 `CursorLedgerStore.shared.rows`（卡片 `ledger.rows`，UsageView:7 `@ObservedObject private var ledger`）。字段语义由 CursorLedger.swift:55-67 定义（四桶 disjoint，`totalTokens` 是其和）。
failure: 维护/漂移：下一次 Cursor 增加一个桶（例如把 cacheWrite 拆成两档）或 `Row` 改字段名时，两处必须同时改且没有任何回归盯着——改错一侧的后果是概览/明细两屏对同一模型显示不同 token 总数（卡片按使用表求和，按模型瓦片按 sourceTokens 求和），而 tests 目前没有任何断言比较两个数（Tests/inventory-performance-regressions.py 只喂 fixture，Tests/cursor-ledger-regressions.py 只编译 CursorLedger.swift + ModelPricing，不编译这两个视图）。
fix: 在 `CursorLedger.Row`（或 `ModelUsage` 的 extension）上加一个 `var asModelUsage: ModelUsage`，两处调用它；这样字段映射只有一份。

summary: 窗口日期区间用未钉 locale 的 `formatted(.dateTime.year().month().day())`，而全仓其它用户可见日期都走 zh_CN（`UsageStats.formatter`）；非 zh_CN 系统区域下卡片会渲染成「Oct 5, 2026–Nov 4, 2026」混在中文卡片里
evidence: CursorTokenUsageCard.swift:17-22 `let start = covered.start.formatted(.dateTime.year().month().day()); let end = covered.end.formatted(.dateTime.year().month().day()); return "\(start)–\(end)"`；对照 UsageStats.swift:56-70 的 `formatter(_:)` 明确 `made.locale = Locale(identifier: "zh_CN")`，并由 CursorLedgerStore.swift:178-180 的 `cursorLedgerShortDate` 用 `UsageStats.formatter("M月d日")` 生成同语义的短标签（`windowLabel`）。应用无本地化资源、无 `environment(\.locale)` 固定（grep 全仓仅上述 zh_CN 硬编码点）。
failure: 输入：系统区域为非 zh_CN（例如 en_US，中文开发者常见）→ 同一个 Cursor 账单窗口在两处显示成两种口径：模型瓦片上的 `settlementWindow` 是「9月28日–10月28日」（CursorLedgerStore.windowLabel），本卡是「Sep 28, 2026–Oct 28, 2026」；且 Cursor 计费窗口按本地时区起止，`formatted` 用当前时区，与短标签口径一致但格式完全不同。观测：同一张用量页上两种日期写法。
fix: 改用 `cursorLedgerShortDate(covered.start)` / `cursorLedgerShortDate(covered.end)`（CursorLedgerStore.swift:178 已有并已被 windowLabel 使用），或给本地 `Date.FormatStyle` 显式 `.locale(Locale(identifier: "zh_CN"))`。

summary: The card re-implements the ledger's window caption with a third date format (`Date.formatted(.dateTime.year().month().day())`) while the rest of the feature captions the same window with `CursorLedgerStore.windowLabel` / `cursorLedgerShortDate` (“9月28日–10月28日”), and `.dateTime` renders in the system locale rather than the app's zh_CN formatters.
evidence: CursorTokenUsageCard.swift:17-22 `covered.start.formatted(.dateTime.year().month().day())` + `"\(start)–\(end)"`; the canonical caption is CursorLedgerStore.swift:101-104 `windowLabel`/`cursorLedgerShortDate` (UsageStats.formatter("M月d日"), zh_CN, cached); that is what UsageView.swift:75 hands to every model tile (`cursorWindowLabel`). UsageStats.swift:38-40 documents that formatters are cached precisely because they are called from `body`; `.dateTime` builds a format style per call in the card's body.
failure: On an en_US-locale macOS the card's own caption reads “Oct 6, 2026–Oct 6, 2026” while the per-model tiles below read “10月6日–10月6日” — two spellings of one window on one page; with the footer line wrapping off (`fixedSize` is horizontal-only) the caption also costs a style build per body pass.
fix: Delete `coverageLabel` and render `ledger.windowLabel ?? ""` (already published and used by UsageView), or call `CursorLedgerStore.windowLabel(ledger.window)` at the call site.

summary: The caption's empty branch is keyed on `ledger.window == nil` and asserts “请先在本机登录 Cursor，再刷新用量。”, but `window` is also nil after a *permission-denied* clear — the card then tells the user to log in when the real cause is the 设置 → 权限与隐私 「读取 Cursor 会话」 switch it does not name (the popup's allowance chip gets `stop()` on that toggle, CursorUsageStore.swift:48-56, while the ledger store is only reached through the page's `.task`/requestSettlement).
evidence: CursorTokenUsageCard.swift:67 `Text(ledger.window == nil ? "请先在本机登录…" : coverageLabel)` and :53 `ledger.window == nil ? "—"`; CursorLedgerStore.swift:115-125 clears rows/window/note when `PermissionGate.allows(.cursorData)` is false, and `PermissionCenter.swift:38/66` shows the switch is user-facing and default-on. CursorUsageStore.swift:39-44 documents that this switch “gates the whole Cursor path, not just the session list”.
failure: User turns the switch off, reopens 用量: the card shows “—”, “官方账单”, and “请先在本机登录 Cursor，再刷新用量。”, with no note (the permission branch sets `note = nil`), so the actionable setting is never mentioned and the login advice is wrong.
fix: Branch the caption on `PermissionGate.allows(.cursorData)` first (or publish a `disabled` flag alongside the clear) and say 「已在设置中关闭『读取 Cursor 会话』」; keep the login sentence for the no-window-success case.

summary: Both the staleness rule (`isStale`: exact interval match, 1 s tolerance) and the note's wording ("仅覆盖上述日期，未覆盖所选周期的完整用量") assume the user can see the dates, but the caption that prints them is the same `Text` whose only arms are the coverage label and the login hint — when `ledger.window != nil` but its day formatter is locale-dependent (finding #2) the note can read “上述日期” while the line above is a different format; more importantly the note also fires while `ledger.loading` in the *narrowed* case where `isStale` is true only because the plan shrank the window, and there is no signal that the request was narrowed rather than simply pending.
evidence: CursorTokenUsageCard.swift:80-87; CursorLedgerStore.swift:85-89 `abs(stored.start - window.start) > 1 || abs(stored.end - window.end) > 1`; CursorLedger.swift:140-158 `plan(for:billingCycle:)` returns a *narrowed* window for year/all periods, and CursorLedgerStore.swift:33-39 says the tile does not need the flag because it captions the money — yet the card uses `isStale` for the note and never `truncated`.
failure: The two failure modes the note distinguishes (“读取中” vs “仅覆盖上述日期”) are both driven by `loading`, so a narrowed-but-complete reading for a year period shows the “仅覆盖上述日期” branch with no mention of the billing-cycle narrowing the store deliberately tracks; a user comparing the card to Cursor's own yearly view reads it as a parse gap rather than a deliberate scope.
fix: Include `ledger.truncated` in the note's copy (e.g. “金额只覆盖账单周期 9月28日–10月28日”) so the flag's stated purpose is finally rendered, or drop the flag and state narrowing here from `ledger.window` vs `window`.

summary: ForEach(Array(rows.enumerated()), id: \.element.id) 每次 body 求值都新建一个数组并把整份 OverviewRow 复制/装箱一次，而 `id: \.element.id` 与 `ForEach(rows)` 的 Identifiable 身份完全等价
evidence: DashboardView.swift:139-143 `TileGrid(.pageSession) { ForEach(Array(rows.enumerated()), id: \.element.id) { _, row in OverviewTile(row: row) { onNavigate(.sessions) } } }`——`rows` 是 `[OverviewRow]`（131 行 `let rows = overviewRows`），OverviewRow 在 181-203 行声明了 `let id: String`，即已满足 Identifiable；闭包体里只用 `row`，enumerated 的 index 没有被使用（解构成 `_`）。
failure: 当前代价：每次 body 通过（会话轮询 2.5s 忙 / 5s 闲、greeting hover 引起的父级更新等）都做一次 `Array(rows.enumerated())`：一次堆分配 + ≤6 个 OverviewRow 的 tuple 复制（每行含 platform/project/activity/contextLabel/updated 等 5 个 String 与多个 Color/Bool/Double）。6 行规模下约 0.5–2 KB/次、触发频率 ≤0.4/s，属于真实但很小的浪费；改成 `ForEach(rows) { row in OverviewTile(row: row) … }` 后为 0 次分配、身份不变（仍是 row.id）。
fix: 删掉枚举：`ForEach(rows) { row in OverviewTile(row: row) { onNavigate(.sessions) } }`（OverviewRow 已 Identifiable）。

summary: 概览瓦片的「相对时间」（relativeUpdated）是轮询时点算好的静态字符串，2.5–5 s 无状态变化就整页不再求值，静止页面上「5s」可停留数分钟才跳一次；同一份数据在灵动岛是 30 s 周期刷新
evidence: ProviderStore.swift:276-279 `if self.sessions != enriched { self.sessions = enriched; … }`、549 `if self.cursorSessions == result { return }`、584 `if self.externalSessions == result { return }`——内容不变即不发布，@ProviderState(.sessions) 的视图不重算；OverviewRow.updated 在 DashboardView:225/247/267 取 `s.relativeUpdated`（SessionMonitor.swift:168-175、CursorSessionMonitor.swift:107-114、ExternalSessionMonitor.swift:127-133 都是 `Date()` 现算的即时字符串，不发布任何随时间变化的状态）；瓦片在 DashboardView:330-332 用 `.rollingNumber(row.updated)` 渲染。同一读数在灵动岛有专门的时间线：IslandComponents.swift:223-225 `TimelineView(.periodic(from: .now, by: 30)) { context in RollingNumberText("等待输入 · " + IslandFormat.ago(session.updatedAt, now: context.date)) }`。
failure: 输入/时序：一个空闲会话停在「45s」，此后没有新增写入（回看窗口内 updatedAt 不变）→ ProviderStore 判等跳过发布 → 概览瓦片一直显示「45s」，直到下一次任何会话内容变化（可能是几分钟后）才跳到「8m」。观测：用户看着一个「已停 45 秒」的会话卡，实际已停 5 分钟；反方向也一样（新写入落在别处、本卡不变时它不会走字）。
fix: 最小改动：在这 6 张瓦片的 updated 文本外用 30 s 粒度的时间源（`TimelineView(.periodic(from: .now, by: 30))` 包住 `Text(row.updated)`，如灵动岛那样），把 `updatedAt` 而非格式化串带进 OverviewRow；不要用每秒时间线——30 s 粒度足够且与 AppConfig 轮询同量级。

summary: 「查看全部 N 个会话」分支与它依赖的 totalSessionCount 在 Tests/ 里没有任何断言：现有 dashboard 回归用的是过滤后的概览行而非完整会话列表，且两个视图从不被编译/渲染
evidence: Tests/dashboard-performance-regressions.py:88-94 的期望只由过滤集合构成：`let expected = (f.providerStore.sessions.filter(\.isAlive).map { "c-\($0.pid)" } + f.providerStore.cursorSessions.map … + f.providerStore.aliveExternalSessions.map …).prefix(6)`，断言 `rows.prefix(6).map(\.id)`；94 行 `precondition(f.totalSessionCount == cc + cursor + external)` 中的 fixture ProviderStore（63-69 行）里 `cursorSessions`/`aliveExternalSessions` 都是无过滤的整表副本，所以它验证的是「总数 = 三表之和」这个恒等式，而不是生产里「alive 过滤 + 溢出按钮」的组合；fixture 里 `DashboardFixture.aliveSessions` 也换成 `sessions.filter(\.isAlive)`，未覆盖 `busySessionCount/activeCursorCount/activeExternalCount`。全仓 grep：`查看全部` 只出现在 DashboardView.swift:146-147/175，没有任何测试或 tool 断言；`OverviewTile` 同样零断言；视图仅在 Tools/render-mainwindow-preview.py:1977（ImageRenderer 截图工具）被挂载，不在 CI 回归清单里（Tests/run-tests.py 的套件列表无对应项）。
failure: 回归缺口：有人改回「用概览行数（≤cap）判溢出」或按来源优先级截断后再算 total 时（正是注释里记录的历史 bug：`prefix(8)` 配 `all.count > 8` 永不渲染），当前测试仍全绿——fixture 的期望正序集合与新实现一致，而 `totalSessionCount` 的断言在 fixture 里恒等成立；只有在真实「活跃会话 > 6 且非 Claude 来源占位」的数据上才暴露（按钮不出现、第 7 个之后的会话在页面上不可见且无提示）。
fix: 在 dashboard-performance-regressions.py 里补一条用生产口径的断言：夹具区分「全部会话」与「alive 子集」（external 表同时含 alive=false 行，现已如此），断言 `total > overviewCap` 时计数等于各源 alive/全量口径之和，或直接对 DashboardView 的 `sessionOverview` 分支做源码断言（存在 `if total > cap`）。

summary: `.rollingNumber("查看全部 \(total) 个会话")` sits on a `Label`, not on the `Text` that draws the digits — exactly the shape 10cfc84 fixed in FanInternalsPanel.swift by switching to the title-closure form, so the figure is still keyed on the container and the roll installs nothing (or, worse, rolls the whole spine when the count changes).
evidence: DashboardView.swift:146-147 `Label("查看全部 \(total) 个会话", systemImage: "arrow.right")` / `.rollingNumber("查看全部 \(total) 个会话")`; the established fix in FanInternalsPanel.swift:17-24 `// The roll belongs to the leaf that draws the digits, not the Label container, so the count takes the title-closure form.` + `Label { Text(...).rollingNumber(...) } icon: { … }`. A repo-wide scan of every `.rollingNumber(` receiver finds this the *only* remaining Label receiver. Interaction.swift:516-541 documents that a site which does not put the roll on the rendering leaf installs `Theme.Animation.roll` over the wrong view.
failure: With >6 live sessions the button's count ticking (a session ending) either swaps digits without the per-digit roll that every other figure in the app has, or applies the numeric transition to the icon+text plate; either way the button is the one rolled figure that cannot be verified to roll.
fix: Title-closure form matching FanInternalsPanel: `Label { Text("查看全部 \(total) 个会话").rollingNumber("查看全部 \(total) 个会话") } icon: { Image(systemName: "arrow.right") }`.

summary: The search/selection reconcile is untested; the only help coverage is markup equality, which never touches selection.
evidence: `recompute()` (HelpView.swift:188-195) and `selectedEntry` (184-186) own the two branches that keep the reader consistent with the rail: re-seed `selected` when the filter drops it, and empty selection on zero matches. `grep -rn 'HelpView|HelpEntry|haystack' Tests/*.py` returns nothing; Tests/remaining-performance-regressions.py:118-135 only compares `HelpInlineMarkdown` output against an uncached parse of the same paragraphs.
failure: A future change that stops re-seeding `selected` leaves the reader showing a stale article (via the `?? matches.first` fallback) or the empty pane behind a non-empty rail, with no failing test.
fix: Add a small Swift fixture (like the palette's `ResultsFixture` in Tests/remaining-performance-regressions.py:44) slicing `recompute`'s filter+reconcile logic, asserting: narrowing to another article re-seeds the selection, and a zero-match query yields an empty selection and no stale reader entry.

summary: The console chases the tail on every appended row with no follow/pause state, so the log cannot be read while requests are flowing.
evidence: `.onChange(of: log.entries.last?.id)` (207-214) unconditionally calls `scrollToEnd(proxy, animated: true)` while the window is visible, and `scrollToEnd` (233-247) always scrolls to `filtered.last`. The sibling console solved this: VpnDomainLogSection has `@State private var followTail = true` (line 33), sets it false when the user scrolls away from the bottom (351-357), guards the chase with `guard followTail, !scrollingDetail` (369-372), and offers a 回到最新 pill (380-388).
failure: With the proxy busy (publishes are coalesced to >=0.1 s), a user who scrolls up to read an earlier line is pulled back to the bottom on the next seal — reading history requires stopping traffic.
fix: Track a `followTail` flag (set false in an `onScrollGeometryChange` when the view leaves the bottom) and skip `scrollToEnd` when it is false, with a 回到最新 pill that resets it.
verdict_note: Verified by source review plus `make build`: the chase is now gated on `followTail`/`tracking`/window visibility and runs without `withAnimation`; `defaultScrollAnchor(.bottom, for: .initialOffset)` carries the initial landing; `LogTokenColumn` figures are `rolls: false`; 清空 routes through a confirm alert shaped like TrafficView's; the stamp-miss path is now `recomputeFiltered`, the hit path a by-id patch (`reconcileFiltered`).

summary: The on-screen token column and the copy-all text are two implementations of the same fold that have drifted on what a missing bucket means.
evidence: On screen, `figure(_:)` renders `value.map(UsageStats.formatTokens) ?? "—"` (ProxyLogView.swift:293-294), so a nil bucket shows `—`. In the copy path, `ProxyLogEntry.tokenField` (ProxyAccessLog.swift:114-129) uses `"入 \(f(promptTokens ?? 0))"`, `"出 \(f(completionTokens ?? 0))"`, `"缓存 \(f(cacheReadTokens ?? 0))"`, turning the same nil into a real `0`, and drops `写入` entirely while the column shows `写入 —`. The module's own contract is that nil is "the upstream never reported usage" and "never a real zero" (ProxyAccessLog.swift:52-58, 101-105).
failure: Copy a row whose upstream reported prompt but no cache counters: the pasted line claims 缓存 0 (and 出 0) while the screen shows —, so a pasted bug report asserts usage that was never reported.
fix: Build the copy buckets with the same optional-preserving fold as the column (`cacheReadTokens.map { "缓存 \(f($0))" }` etc., `—` for nil), or have `tokenField` reuse the column's per-bucket formatter.
verdict_note: Verified by source review plus `make build`: the chase is now gated on `followTail`/`tracking`/window visibility and runs without `withAnimation`; `defaultScrollAnchor(.bottom, for: .initialOffset)` carries the initial landing; `LogTokenColumn` figures are `rolls: false`; 清空 routes through a confirm alert shaped like TrafficView's; the stamp-miss path is now `recomputeFiltered`, the hit path a by-id patch (`reconcileFiltered`).

summary: Codex 卡每次渲染用 `children.flatMap(\.flattened)` 复制整棵子树数组，两个 body 各做一次；另有两处用 filter 分配整数组只为取计数，而 O(1) 的 descendantCount 就存在节点上。
evidence: SessionsView.swift:746-748 `static func swarmAgents(of node: ProviderStore.ExternalSessionNode) -> [ExternalSessionInfo] { node.children.flatMap(\.flattened) }`；调用点 781（`ExternalSessionTile.body`）与 950（`ExternalSessionGridCard.body`）；881 `let running = agents.filter(\.isActive).count`（只为计数分配数组）；AgentSwarmView.swift:385-386 的 `accessibilityText` 同样是 `children.filter(\.isActive).count`。对照 ProviderStore+Derived.swift:75 `var descendantCount: Int { flattened.count - 1 }` 是已存储的 O(1) 计数，但判空/计数都没用它。1036 行 `children: Array(agents.prefix(Self.strip.visible))` 只取前 9 个，却先复制了全量。
failure: 一个根会话挂 200 个活跃 helper 时，每张可见 Codex 卡（tile 或 grid card）每次会话轮询分配一个约 200 元素的 ExternalSessionInfo 数组（约 3KB，含逐元素 ARC），grid card 还额外做一次只取 9 个的 prefix 拷贝；扇出越大，浪费按元素数线性增长，且节点值每次都是新发布，SwiftUI 无法判等跳过。
fix: 判空改用 `node.descendantCount != 0`；计数改用 `agents.reduce(0) { $0 + ($1.isActive ? 1 : 0) }`；在 ExternalSessionNode 里存一份 `descendants: ArraySlice<ExternalSessionInfo>`（建树时构造一次，树本身按发布缓存），让 `swarmAgents` 直接返回它，消除每次 body 的整树复制。
verdict_note: Code: `ExternalSessionNode` now stores `descendants` (`[session] + descendants` folded once at build time) instead of `flattened`; `descendantCount` is `descendants.count`, `swarmAgents` returns the stored array (the two body call sites and the popup's `childAgents` no longer allocate a per-render `flatMap`), and both `.filter(\.isActive).count` counts are folds.

summary: `activeAgentCount` 恒等于 `descendantCount`：建树时子节点按 isActive 过滤，因此区头 note 的「无运行」分支与 tertiary noteTint 永远不可达。
evidence: SessionsView.swift:186-188 `let activeAgents = tree.reduce(0) { $0 + $1.activeDescendantCount }` / `let agents = tree.reduce(0) { $0 + $1.descendantCount }`；ProviderStore+Derived.swift:97-104 建树时 `let children = (childrenOf[session.sessionId] ?? []).filter { $0.isActive && !visited.contains($0.sessionId) }`，children 数组里的每个节点都 active，于是 :69-71 的 `activeDescendantCount = children.reduce(0) { $0 + $1.activeDescendantCount + ($1.session.isActive ? 1 : 0) }` 归纳地等于 descendantCount（叶节点两边都是 0；非叶两边都等于 Σ(子.descendantCount+1)）。Tests/e2e-codex-tree.py:97-101 也只对 `activeHelpers` 断言。
failure: 只要 agentCount>0，note 就必然是 `+N agent · N 运行` 且 noteTint 必然是 success（SessionsView.swift:258-263 的三元；`+N agent` 与 textTertiary 分支死掉）；同时「已结束的 helper 被建树时静默剔除」这一语义被一个看似在区分活跃度的双计数掩盖，读代码的人会以为两个数字可以不等。
fix: 删掉第二个 reduce 与 note 的三态，直接用 `agents`（或保留一个 reduce 并把 noteTint 固定为 success）；若确实想表达「运行中的子 agent 数」，那需要先修改建树逻辑保留已结束的子节点——而不是在这里再算一遍。superseded by the tree filter。

summary: `waitingActivity` 的 `isEmpty` 兜底分支不可达：`SessionInfo.waitingReason` 在 isWaiting 为真时永远非空。
evidence: SessionsView.swift:478-480 `private var waitingActivity: String { session.waitingReason.isEmpty ? "等待你确认" : session.waitingReason }`；SessionMonitor.swift:117-141 的每个分支都返回非空字面量（`case "": return waitingFor == "input needed" ? "等待你选择" : "等待你确认"`，default 返回 `"等待你确认 · \(pendingTool)"`），仅 `guard isWaiting else { return "" }` 可为空，而调用点 388 只在 isWaiting 时为真才取它。SessionCardView.swift:116-118 的注释也确认了这条不变量（"its own `""` arm resolves to 等待你确认 — so it needs no default here"）。同一兜底被复制到 DashboardView.swift:221、IslandComponents.swift:241、NotchIslandView.swift:533、NotificationService.swift:108。
failure: 无运行时后果，但五处各自持有一份「可能为空」的假设；将来一旦 waitingReason 变为可空（或新增返回空串的分支），这五处的兜底文案会各自漂移，而编译器不会提示任何一处。

summary: 设置页既无回归也无离线预览，设计文档里承诺的两条草稿规则（密钥只在「保存」/回车提交、端口只在「应用」/回车后校验并重启）没有任何机器检查
evidence: `grep -rn "SettingsView" Tests/ Tools/` 无命中（Tests 下只有 SettingsManager/ProviderStore 级别的用例，与设置页 UI 无关）；Tools/render-mainwindow-preview.py 的 pages() 只渲染 overview/sessions/usage/vpn/traffic（文件末尾 pages() 定义），docs/design/surfaces/settings.md:42 自己写明「`Tools/render-mainwindow-preview.py` 渲染概览、会话、用量、VPN、流量五页，不含设置页；设置页没有离线预览入口。草稿语义由源码保证」。而 SettingsView.swift:253-256 的注释（「an explicit save… a blur-commit gives no confirmation that the secret was stored」）说明 blur-commit 密钥正是不能犯的错——这一条目前只靠读源码保证。
failure: 日后把 SecureField 的 .onSubmit 换成 .onChange 提交、或把端口校验的 1024...65535 改松/改错、或 amapKeyEdited 的比较改成 trim 前的字符串，都不会有任何测试变红；这类改动会直接写出用户没确认的凭据或重启代理到无效端口。

summary: `providerRequest` (and its owners array) is rebuilt and deep-compared on every body pass purely to feed `.task(id:)` equality.
evidence: UsageView.swift:49-59: `providerRequest` maps `providerStore.providers` and `codexStore.providers` into `UsageProviderInventory.Owner(source:name:models: $0.models.map(\.name))` and returns a struct used only as `.task(id: providerRequest)` (line 185). Each body evaluation therefore allocates two arrays and one Owner per provider, and compares the whole struct against the previous value. The repo's own measured fixture treats 40 providers × 100 models as the interesting scale (Tests/measured-performance-regressions.py:161-164).
failure: During an FSEvents burst (~2.5 publishes/s with a session writing) the usage page re-evaluates its body on each publish; each pass wraps and compares ~4000 model-name strings (40×100) in addition to the view diff, for an id whose only real inputs are the interval and whether the sources changed.
fix: Cache `owners` in `@State` refreshed via `.onChange(of: providerStore.providers)` / `.onChange(of: codexStore.providers)`, or key the task on a cheap `(interval, sources.count, official.count)`-style tuple so the owners array is not rebuilt for the equality check.

summary: 标题栏的 ProgressView 始终挂载，空闲时靠 opacity(0) 隐藏——macOS 的不定进度指示器在不可见时仍可能在动画
evidence: UsageView.swift:137-140 `ProgressView().controlSize(.small).frame(width: 16, height: 16).opacity(providerStore.usageLoading || providerStore.usagePublishedInterval != interval ? 1 : 0).accessibilityHidden(...)`——用 opacity 而不是条件挂载。仓库已有两处实测记录表明 opacity(0) 保留的子树仍在提交显示周期：TrafficView.swift:6「The page used to stay mounted forever (opacity(0) when another tab was…)」、ProxyLogView.swift:211「(that loop used to run at 170 scrolls/s with the page hidden behind opacity(0))」。
failure: 页面空闲（interval 已发布、loading 为 false）时，这个 NSProgressIndicator 仍留在窗口层级里按自己的时钟转；每次提交多一次小图层的绘制。CPU 成本大概率远小于 1%（远小于历史上整棵 hosting view 的 18–20%），所以列为 low。
fix: 改成条件挂载并保留同一格的占位：`if providerStore.usageLoading || providerStore.usagePublishedInterval != interval { ProgressView().controlSize(.small) } else { Color.clear.frame(width: 16, height: 16) }`（accessibilityHidden 随之简化）。
verdict_note: Same fix as 344 (duplicate finding).

summary: 新增订阅路径不设 busyID：下载期间无进度、无重入锁，慢订阅可被重复添加
evidence: VPNSubscriptionSection.swift:195-200 `case .add: await store.addSubscription(name: name, url: url); if store.errorMessage == nil, manager.isRunning { manager.reloadConfig() }` —— 不设 busyID；而同文件的「更新节点配置」(126-133) 与「查询流量」(134-140) 都先 `busyID = sub.id`，菜单/按钮也以 `busyID != nil` 禁用（150、166）。addSubscription 内部对同一 URL 不做去重（VpnSubscriptionStore.swift:82-105 直接 append）。downloadProfile 最多尝试 4 个 UA，每个 timeout 45 s。

summary: `gridW > 0` 恒为真：gridW 在 154 行已是 max(1, size.width)，else 分支不可达

summary: nameInline 字段恒为 false,生产代码无任何读取方(除测试断言),是可删的遗留字段

summary: phraseChanged 只在 input 的 didSet 里更新,若新输入在本帧被消解前又换回,写笔重播会漏掉或多播一次
evidence: `var input: Input? { didSet { if input?.layout?.phrase != oldValue?.layout?.phrase { phraseChanged = true } } }`(line 519)。phraseChanged 只在 `install` 里被消费并清 0(line 825-826:`if phraseChanged, textTexture != nil, !reduceMotion, !capturing { rewrite() }` 紧接 `phraseChanged = false`)。中间路径 `updateText` 在 key 未变时提前返回(line 780:`guard key != textKey else { requested = nil; return }`),不会清 phraseChanged;capturing 时走同步 install 也会消费它。因此一次「输入 A→B→A」的翻转若两次都被 set(每次 didSet 都置 true),install 只会重播一次,但若 A→B 后 B 的纹理尚未装好、输入又回到 A,则 phraseChanged 被置 true,下一次 install 是 A 的纹理,会触发一次多余的 rewrite。
failure: 小时翻转(phrase 变化)与用户同时改字体/尺寸时,可能出现一次没有实际换句的写笔重播(可观测:问候重新写一遍);反之 phrase 从 B 变回 A 且纹理命中时,真正的新句不会被重播。两方向都不会崩,只是错一次动画。
fix: 把比对基准从 `input?.layout?.phrase` 改为 `(input?.layout?.phrase, input?.layout?.typeface, input?.layout?.fontSize)` 之类的完整文本键,或者在 install 里改用 `key != oldKey` 判定,而不是独立旗标。

summary: 闪电在场景仍为雷雨但帧时钟回拨时会在同一 now 上反复抽签并把 nextFlash 推后,连续抽签的随机数消耗没有上限
evidence: line 963 `if now >= nextFlash { ... }` 全部在 render 帧内执行;`nextFlash = now + onset + (quick ? 1.1...2.5 : 2.5...8)`(lines 975-976)。`onset` 由随机数累加而来(0.04-0.13,line 971),所以 `nextFlash` 至少是 now+1.1 s。单次抽签的 rng 调用约 6-12 次(`Double.random` x2, `Float.random` x2, `Int.random`, 每个 stroke 再 2 次)。注意 `skyDue` 里的闪电分支使 lastSkyTime 跟随每帧,但 `now` 来自 encode 的调用方。
failure: 只要 now 单调(生产路径 CACurrentMediaTime 单调)就不会重复触发;唯一风险在 bench/测试把 now 当参数反复传同一值时(encode 的 now 是默认参数,Tools/bench-atmosphere.py 就显式传 now)。重复调用同一 now 只会多消耗 rng,不改变输出,因为 flashStart 与 age 相同 → 结果幂等。属于低风险。
fix: 在 `now >= nextFlash` 分支前加 `guard now > flashStart` 或把抽签移到 `now - flashStart` 的守卫后,避免同一时间戳反复抽签。
verdict_note: Verified in the 2026-10-07 recheck: after the draw nextFlash = now + onset + >=1.1, strictly greater than now, so repeated calls at the same instant cannot re-draw.

summary: 天气刷新循环在卡片不可见时也因为 task id 依赖 surfaceVisible 而被取消，但取消发生在 sleep 中途；可见后立即 refreshIfStale 已处理；可记录的性能浪费是 staleAfter+15s 的固定 15 分钟节奏对公共 endpoint 是合理值（无缺陷）。——此项经核实无缺陷，仅记录以免被误报。

failure: 无。
fix: 无需改动。

summary: 面板的 RSSI 尺在位置 0（rssi ≤ −100 dBm 被 clamp）仍点亮第 0 格，而卡片端画同一把尺的 mark 明确加了 floor 不点亮任何格，两块「必须对同一读数说同一句话」的表面在量程底部互相矛盾。
evidence: 面板填充条件是 `Double(index) / Double(Self.cellCount - 1) <= $0`（HardwareDetailPanel.swift:443-445），index 0 时 0 <= 0 恒真，所以 position == 0 也亮一格；position 来自第 416 行的 `min(1, max(0, Double($0 + 100) / 60))`。卡片端 SignalCellRow 对同一公式加了 floor：`let lit = strength > 0.001 ? max(1, Int((strength * Double(Self.count - 1)).rounded()) + 1) : 0`（ConnectionCard.swift:284-285），并在 280-283 行注释写明这个公式会在 0.0 点亮第 0 格、为「离线卡片凭空声称一格信号」而加了下限。实测分支：`status.rssi` 只要 `wifiOn && wifiRSSI < 0` 就非 nil（ConnectionCard.swift:346），所以 rssi == −100 或更低时卡片 strength = WiFiBars.fraction = 0 → 0 格，面板 position = 0 → 1 格。Tests/connection-panel-regressions.py 只断言两边共用 `Double(rssi + 100) / 60` 这个字符串（第 96 行）与面板仍画 `ConnectionSignalScale`（第 93 行），点亮格数的规则没有任何回归覆盖。
failure: Wi-Fi 距离远/隔墙读到 ≤ −100 dBm 时：概览连接卡片的 mark 显示 0 格（无信号），点开同一个卡片弹出的 popover 里 RSSI 尺却显示 1 格（最弱一档），同一 reading 两个长度——正是这两个组件被重写成共享一把尺时要消除的分歧。
fix: 让面板复用卡片的规则：position 为 0 时一律填 `Self.emptyCell`（例如把 444 行的谓词改成 `position.map { $0 > 0 && Double(index) / Double(Self.cellCount - 1) <= $0 } == true`），并在 connection-panel-regressions.py 里把「rssi −100 时两边分别是 0/0 格」钉成断言。

summary: RSSI→尺位换算在面板里把 WiFiBars.fraction 的公式原样重抄了一遍，而不是调用卡片端已有的唯一实现；两处只共享了字面数字，没有共享函数。
evidence: ConnectionCard.swift:308-311 `static func fraction(for rssi: Int) -> Double { min(1, max(0, Double(rssi + 100) / 60)) }`；HardwareDetailPanel.swift:416 `private var position: Double? { rssi.map { min(1, max(0, Double($0 + 100) / 60)) } }`。卡片端的文档注释（ConnectionCard.swift:270-273、404-405 附近）明确说面板「keeps the same rule in `ConnectionSignalScale.position`」，但共享的只是分母 60 这个数字。WiFiBars 是同模块 internal，面板完全可以直接调用。Tests/connection-panel-regressions.py:96 只断言卡片源文本里出现 `Double(rssi + 100) / 60`，面板那份没有任何测试。
failure: 量程需要调整时（例如从 −100…−40 改为 −90…−30，或把 60 提成常量），两处各自修改而漏掉一处：同一 dBm 在卡片 mark 与 popover 尺上画出两个长度，而现有回归测试仍然全绿（它只钉字符串存在性）。
fix: 改为 `private var position: Double? { rssi.map(WiFiBars.fraction(for:)) }`，让尺位只有一个定义。

summary: 面板 CPU/GPU 的百分比用默认 rolls=true 绑在采样器 1–2 s 节奏发布的读数上，而同一个读数在概览条上被本仓明确设为 rolls:false——同一仓库自己测量并记录的「每 tick 新开动画事务」成本。
evidence: HardwareDetailPanel.swift:109 `RollingNumberText(String(format: "%.1f%%", load))`（load = `sampler.host.cpu/gpu`，第 100 行）与第 117 行 `Text("峰值 …").rollingNumber(…)` 都未传 `rolls: false`；同一读数在 ResourceStrip.swift:267 用 `RollingNumberText(hero, rolls: false)`，其注释写明「ProcessSampler 以 2 s（会话活跃时 1 s）重发 host，a roll keyed on each reading would open a fresh animated transaction per sample and put the whole card through a display cycle per tick」。Interaction.swift:425-437 与 Tests/inflight-animation-regressions.py 的动机（事务在飞行中时每个显示周期重跑 hosting view 布局，实测 31%）都要求采样节奏的 gauge 数字不滚动。
failure: 打开 CPU/GPU popover 期间，百分比每变化一次就开一个 0.2 s 的动画事务（109 行）并叠加峰值行（117 行），在事务在飞行的显示周期里让 popover 所在的 hosting view 重复布局——与概览条为避免同一成本而特意关掉滚动的读数完全相同。
fix: 两处改为 `RollingNumberText(..., rolls: false)` / `.rollingNumber(figure, rolls: false)`，与同一读数的其他表面保持一致。

summary: 主窗口连续缩放时，每次 layout 都因 lane/bar 矩形随 bounds 变化而走 rebuild：把每个 busy bar 的 clip + gradient 层全部删除重建（含一条无限重复 CABasicAnimation），而不是就地更新 frame。
evidence: `override func layout() { super.layout(); sync() }`（HardwareIllustration.swift:323-326）；sync 里 `let placed = HardwareIllustration.placement(in: bounds.size)`（356 行）与 `laneBars(..., lane: placed.lane)`（357-358 行）在缩放中每帧都变；366 行 `if next != bars || tintChanged || sheens.count != next.filter(\.busy).count { rebuild(next) }`；rebuild（393-438 行）先 `clips.forEach { $0.removeFromSuperlayer() }`，再为每个 busy bar 新建 CALayer + CAGradientLayer 并 `sheen.add(move, forKey: "sweep")`。文件自己的注释（296-301 行）也确认 rebuild 会发生在「a reading change, a tint change, a live resize」。`updateNSView` 同样每次更新调 sync()。
failure: 拖动主窗口边缘缩放概览页时，每个显示帧对每块 CPU/GPU/内存/硬盘 mark 删除并重建至多「核数」个图层与渐变层（4 块 mark 同屏），把纯几何变化变成逐帧的图层分配 + Core Animation 提交；分辨率越高越明显。
fix: 把几何变化从 rebuild 中拆出：busy 集合或 tint 变化才重建，bounds 变化时按索引复用 `clips[i]`/`sheens[i]` 就地更新 `frame`、`cornerRadius` 与 sheen 的 `frame`（或仅在 `placed.lane` 改变时才重算 layer 几何）。

summary: `trail.isEmpty` 的 8 格占位分支不可达：唯一调用点在 nil 时根本不构造该视图，而写入端保证存下来的每条 trail 至少 1 个样本。
evidence: 唯一调用点 SessionCardView.swift:85-87 `if let heartbeat { HeartbeatSparkline(trail: heartbeat) }`，heartbeat 来自 `providerStore.heartbeats[session.pid]`（SessionsPanel.swift:30）；写入端 ProviderStore.recordHeartbeats（ProviderStore.swift:298-315）对 `samples` 里每个 alive pid 都 `trail.append(busy)`（≥1），末尾 `next = next.filter { live.contains($0.key) }` 只删条目、不产生空数组，`samples` 为空时整表清空成 `[:]`。`grep -rn HeartbeatSparkline Tests/` 无任何引用，也无人用 `[]` 构造。
failure: 无当前运行时表现；代价是它把「空数据会画出 8 格占位刻度」写成契约却永不执行，一旦有人为了固定宽度把调用点改成 `HeartbeatSparkline(trail: heartbeat ?? [])`，会静默换成占位刻度而没有任何测试或注释提示语义已变。
fix: 删除 16-24 行的空分支（`trail` 非空即可直接画），或在调用点显式表达「无历史不画」并删掉占位造型。

summary: The in-app manual instructs `killall ClaudeBar`, the exact name-wide process kill the repo's own rules forbid, and it skips the quit cleanup path the app implements.
evidence: HelpCatalog.swift:506 `.code("killall ClaudeBar\nopen /Applications/ClaudeBar.app")`. AGENTS.md rule 7 bans `killall ClaudeBar` / `pkill ClaudeBar`. The app installs no SIGTERM/SIGINT handler (grep over Sources: only `kill(pid, SIGTERM)` at VpnManager.swift:379; no DispatchSourceSignal/sigaction), so a SIGTERM never runs `applicationWillTerminate` (ClaudeBarApp.swift:232-253: `VpnManager.shared.stopCore()`, `VpnSystemProxyController.clearSystemProxy()`, `FanMonitor.shared.adoptSystemControlOnQuit()`, hotkey stop). The comment at ClaudeBarApp.swift:225-231 states the orphan-core + system-proxy residue case this cleanup exists for.
failure: A user following 改了源码但界面没变 kills the running app by name; the mihomo core is orphaned (PPID 1) with the system proxy still applied until the next launch's `reapOrphanCore`, and the shipped manual documents an operation the repo explicitly forbids.
fix: Replace the code block with `osascript -e 'tell application "ClaudeBar" to quit'` (or the menu 退出), which is the app's own clean-quit path.

summary: The manual hard-codes release-channel paths and freezes runtime facts in a `static let`, so both are wrong in dev builds and stale after a settings change.
evidence: `static let entries` (HelpCatalog.swift:114) bakes in `\(LocalProxyAddress.port)` / `\(LocalProxyAddress.openaiRoot)` (lines 215-216, 244) at first access — changing 监听端口 in Settings leaves the manual quoting the old Base URL until relaunch. The Application Support paths are hard-coded to the release channel: `~/Library/Application Support/ClaudeBar/proxy-token` (line 229), `.../logs/` (260, 494), `.../vpn/` (495), and mixed-port `7890` (340, 352), although `FilePaths.appSupportDir` is `Application Support/\(BuildChannel.appName)` (FilePaths.swift:61-63; dev name "ClaudeBar Dev", build-config.sh:6) and dev's `vpnMixedPort` is 17890 (BuildChannel.swift:36). The file already interpolates runtime values elsewhere, so the pattern exists.
failure: In a dev build the manual's proxy-token/logs/vpn paths name directories that do not exist; in any build, changing the proxy port makes the 第三方客户端接入 Base URL in the manual wrong until relaunch.
fix: Interpolate `BuildChannel.appName` and `BuildChannel.vpnMixedPort` at those six string sites, and make the port/address strings recomputed (a `static var` read where rendered, or read `LocalProxyAddress` inside the view) instead of frozen in the static catalog.

summary: `HelpEntry.keywords` is stored but never read anywhere; only the init parameter is used, and only to build `haystack`.
evidence: HelpCatalog.swift:83 is the sole reference to the stored property (`self.keywords = keywords`); `grep -rn 'keywords' Sources Tests Tools` finds no other read outside the initializer, and `haystack` is assembled in the same init from the parameter (line 85), never from the field.
failure: No runtime effect; the field is dead state that reads as if something consumed it (the doc comment says "Extra search terms ... Not displayed"), tempting future code to write it expecting behavior.
fix: Keep the init parameter (it feeds `haystack`), drop the stored `let keywords: String` — or surface it, e.g. as the rail row's `.help` text alongside `summary`.

summary: 筛选对每个候选名每次求值都新建一份 lowercased()，行内又重复一次 lowercased 与两次 Set 查询；候选来自任意 /models 列表，可达数百上千条。
evidence: ModelImportSheet.swift:31-35 `let q = filter.trimming…lowercased(); return candidates.filter { $0.lowercased().contains(q) }` —— 每个候选一次小写分配；58-90 的 List 行内 60 行 `existingNames.contains(name.lowercased())` 第三份 lowercased，72 行与 63 行各一次 `selection.contains(name)`；`candidates` 由 ProviderModelFetchButton.swift:55 直接取自 ModelListFetcher 的 payload（ProviderModelFetchButton.swift:33），聚合型 /models 常见 300+ 条。对照：同仓 ProviderDirectory.swift:97 与 100-104 已经把 searchTerm 与 haystack 的小写做成一次。
failure: 在「筛选模型名称」里每敲一个字符，对 N 个候选做 N 次 lowercased + N 次子串搜索（N=1000 时约 50–100 KB 瞬时字符串churn/键），可见行的每次重绘再各自 lowercased 一次；无正确性影响，纯重复分配。
fix: 在 init 或 `onChange(of: candidates)` 里一次算出 `[(name: String, key: String, exists: Bool)]`（key = name.lowercased()，exists 用同一 key 查），filtered/行渲染都用它；`selection` 继续存原始名，行内改用预计算的 exists。

summary: 导入集合的唯一去重规则（大小写不敏感地排除已存在名）没有任何回归覆盖，而它的两个调用方中 ProviderQuickSetup 追加时不做去重。
evidence: grep 全 Tests/ 目录对 `ModelImportSheet`、`ProviderModelFetchButton` 零命中（仅 Tests/ui-regressions.py:109 引用了 ModelPriceCard.swift）；ModelImportSheet.swift:27-29 的 `candidates.filter { !existingNames.contains($0.lowercased()) }` 同时决定初始勾选与「全选可导入」（114 行）。调用方：ProviderConnectionEditor.swift:349-359 的 add 自己去重，但 ProviderQuickSetup.swift:71 `draft.additionalModels.append(contentsOf: names.sorted())` 不去重。
failure: 若 importable 的 lowercased 或 existingNames 的约定被改动（例如调用方不再 lowercased 传入，或去掉 lowercased），sheet 会放行与已有模型只差大小写的名字；快速设置路径直接 append，出现两条只差大小写的额外模型并写进客户端配置，且现有套件不会有任何一条变红——只有运行到该 UI 路径才能发现。
fix: 在 Tests/ 增一个切片回归：把 importable 从源文件切出（与 ui-regressions.py 切 shouldDrawDraft 同法），用 {狼} 覆盖「候选大小写不同」「existingNames 大小写不同」「空候选」「全被排除」四种输入，断言返回集合；或最小改动——让 startAdding/importable 的结果在 ProviderQuickSetup.swift:71 追加前再经一次 `Set(map { $0.lowercased() })` 去重。

summary: Nothing under Tests/ references ModelImportSheet or its import rule, so the case-insensitive exclusion of already-configured models is unverified while the sibling card got a purpose-built regression.
evidence: `grep -rn "ModelImportSheet|importable" Tests/` returns no hits (the only references are in Sources/ClaudeBar/Views/Shared/ProviderModelFetchButton.swift:33 and the sheet itself). The rule under test would be `candidates.filter { !existingNames.contains($0.lowercased()) }` (line 28), whose correctness depends on a contract the sheet does not state — both callers must pre-lower-case the other side (`ProviderQuickSetup.swift:70`, `ProviderConnectionEditor.swift:225`). Meanwhile the adjacent view was given exactly this treatment: Tests/ui-regressions.py:112-127 slices and executes ModelPriceCard's `shouldDrawDraft` predicate and textually pins `startAdding`.
failure: A refactor that drops the `.lowercased()` term (or a caller that stops lower-casing existing names, e.g. ProviderQuickSetup's `draft.additionalModels.append(contentsOf: names.sorted())`, which does no dedupe of its own) makes an already-configured model appear importable and importable twice — and no test goes red, because the sheet and its rule have no regression at all.
fix: Add a slice to Tests/ui-regressions.py in the same style as the draft predicate: hoist `importable(_:notIn:)` into a fixture and assert `importable(["GLM-5", "glm-4"], notIn: ["glm-5"]) == ["glm-4"]`, plus that 全选可导入 sets the same set as the initial selection.

summary: 每一行每一轮 body 重复 3–4 次 activeOverride（每次都现算 dayKey）与 1 次全表 resolve；卡片层每轮 body 又重建 3–5 次 allSlugs（含排序）。
evidence: PriceRow.body 在 385、387、435、479 四次调用 `catalog.activeOverride(for: slug)`；ModelPriceCatalog.swift:146-149 每次调用都执行 `ModelPricing.dayKey(Date())`（ModelPricing.swift:481-484 = Calendar.current.dateComponents + String(format:)）。400 行 `catalog.resolution(for: slug)` → ModelPricing.resolve（445-469）对每行做一次 56 条表项 + 7 条 unpriced + 全部 override 的扫描，并且 canonical()（629-669）每行至少再跑两次 NSRegularExpression 匹配（sourceURL(for:) 里也调 usdVendor→canonical）；caption:87 用 `catalog.allSlugs.count`，rows:268-269 再取一次 allSlugs，而 allSlugs（ModelPriceCatalog.swift:129-142）每次访问都新建 Set + append + `.sorted()`（约 63 个 slug），rows 在一次 body 里被求值 2 次（289、293），有 draft 时还会经 275/316 各再求值一次，每次都对 63 个 slug 做 lowercased()。
failure: 设置页打开时，每次搜索键入 / candidates / report 发布 / 编辑开关都会触发卡片 body：约 12–15 个可见行 × (3–4 次 Calendar 日键 + 一次全表 resolve) + 3–5 次 63 元排序与 lowercase，数量级约 10² 次可避免的分配与扫描（官方实测 ModelPriceCard body 1.552 ms，见 docs/reviews/apple-release-performance-audit-2026-10-04.md:31，该值在每次键入都重付一遍）。
fix: PriceRow.body 顶部 `let override = catalog.activeOverride(for: slug)`（局部 let，ViewBuilder 允许）复用给 385/387/435/479；卡片刻一次 `let today = ModelPricing.dayKey(Date())` 并新增 `activeOverride(for:today:)`；`allSlugs` 改成 `private(set) var` 存储属性，在 load()/commit() 里重算，caption 用 `slugCount`；list 内把 `rows` 提成局部常量只算一次。

summary: The vendor-page lookup compares a lower-cased slug against MiniMax's capitalised slug list, so the three MiniMax rows never get their official pricing-page link even though the card knows the URL.
evidence: `for vendor in ModelPriceSources.vendors where vendor.slugs.contains(slug) { return vendor.url }` (lines 322-325). MiniMax is the one vendor whose list is not lower-case: `slugs: ["MiniMax-M3", "MiniMax-M2.7", "MiniMax-M2.7-highspeed"]` (ModelPriceSources.swift:76-78), while `parseMiniMax` emits `slug: name.lowercased()` (line 438) and the bundled table stores `minimax-m3` / `minimax-m2.7` (ModelPriceTable.swift:123-125). The slugs the card passes in come from `catalog.allSlugs`, which is bundled table keys + `ModelPriceTable.unpriced` keys + override keys — all lower-case, and overrides are lower-cased by `record` (`ModelPricing.canonical(trimmed)` must equal `trimmed`, ModelPriceCatalog.swift:209-212). So `.contains` can never match for MiniMax, `sourceURL` returns nil, and `PriceRow.actions`' `arrow.up.right.square` chip is not drawn for those rows (line 473).
failure: Every MiniMax row (a user with 用量 on minimax-m2.7, say) shows 内置 with no link to platform.minimaxi.com's pricing page, for the only vendor whose numbers come from that page — the auditable-by-link promise the card's design notes lead with is quietly unavailable for those rows, and `vendor.slugs` has no other reader that could reveal the mismatch.
fix: Compare case-insensitively in sourceURL(for:): `for vendor in ModelPriceSources.vendors where vendor.slugs.contains(where: { $0.lowercased() == slug }) { return vendor.url }` (or lower-case MiniMax's three entries in ModelPriceSources.vendors).

summary: The card builds two private uncached DateFormatters for date shapes the app already serves through the cached, time-zone-keyed UsageStats.formatter, and unlike that helper they pin the zone at first use.
evidence: `private static let day: DateFormatter = { ... made.dateFormat = "M月d日" ... }` (lines 97-102) and `private static let stamp: DateFormatter` with `"M月d日 HH:mm"` (464-469), both constructed once as `static let`. The shared helper is `UsageStats.formatter(_:)`, which caches by `format + zone` and re-resolves `TimeZone.current` per call precisely so a zone change does not leave stale labels (UsageStats.swift:46-70); other day labels already route through it (CursorLedgerStore.swift:179, UsageHeatmap.swift:193, VpnTopChrome.swift:231, IslandComponents.swift:543), and ModelPricing.format's own doc points there ("see the cached formatters in UsageStats", ModelPricing.swift:701).
failure: Timing/state: the card's 上次查询 day (line 92) and 写入于 stamp (line 452) are rendered by formatters frozen in the zone that was current when the static was first touched, while every other date in the app follows `UsageStats`'s keyed cache — after a time-zone change mid-session the same override's day is printed in two different zones by the two helpers (the drift UsageStats.swift:46-50 documents fixing), and nothing in Tests pins either copy.
fix: Delete both statics and call the shared helper: `UsageStats.formatter("M月d日")` at line 92 and `UsageStats.formatter("M月d日 HH:mm")` at line 452.

summary: Claude 转录「先全量解析、再追加增长」这条主路径没有任何回归：夹具里 Claude 侧只有一次写入和一次整文件重写。
evidence: 该文件对 Claude 的写入共四处（180、273、277 行的单次 write，以及 154 行的写空）；180 行 `try Data((assistant(1) + assistant(10)).utf8).write(to: claude...session.jsonl)` 是一次完整写入（此前 154 行已把文件写成 0 字节，所以这次仍是 size 缩减/新建语义），此后 Claude 文件不再有截断追加（非 0 字节增长）——即 UsageIndex.sync 中 `prior != nil && file.size > prior.size` 的 Claude 分支（811 行整文件重解析）从未被执行。Codex 侧有专门的跨追加边界用例（126-138 行）。
failure: 如果将来把 Claude 改成增量解析（或改动 replaceRollup/claimClaude 与追加的交互），现有 42 组回归全部通过也无法发现 Claude 追加路径的回归——而这正是生产里最常见的形态（每次 assistant 行追加都会命中）。

verdict_note: Claude pure-append path landed in 34b6c87 with additive/reprint/sandwich assertions in Tests/usage-index-regressions.py (this is the 2026-10-07 coverage the finding asked for). Rechecked 2026-10-07.

summary: The only automated consumer of the island preview tool is the promo-film script; its declaration-slice + compile guard never runs in `make test` or CI.
evidence: `grep -rn render-island-preview` finds no Makefile/CI/Tests reference — only `Tools/render-promo-film.py:92` invokes it. The tool has a windowless gate (`--check` at line 375-380: "runs every declaration lookup and the compile, and stops before the launch") and fails loudly when a slice moves (line 160-162: "NotchIslandView.body no longer matches the shape this renderer strips preferences out of"). The repo already has the precedent for gating another tool's `--check`: Tests/icon-minimal-regressions.py:7-11 records "both claimed the test suite ran `--check`, and no suite did" and now runs it.
failure: A refactor of `NotchIslandView.body`, or a moved/renamed declaration the probe slices, breaks only the promo-art path: nobody sees it until the film is rendered, while every other surface has a suite that fails at commit time. The island's views (shape math, histogram scrub, source split) have no compiled regression at all — only substring assertions in Tests/product-mark-regressions.py:111-141.
fix: Add a one-line suite (e.g. Tests/island-preview-regressions.py) that runs `python3 Tools/render-island-preview.py --check` as a subprocess and asserts exit 0, and register it in TEST_SUITES; the `--check` path needs only swiftc, which CI already has.
verdict_note: Fixed 2026-10-07: `Tests/render-preview-regressions.py` (registered as `render-preview` in `TEST_SUITES`) runs both tools' `--check` in `make test`. Wiring it flushed out that the failure was not hypothetical: the popup probe was already dead at HEAD (stub drift — `AppPreferences.costDisplay`, `ExchangeRate`, `TokenMagnitude`, the real `FilePaths`, `ExternalSessionNode.descendants`), and the island probe with it (`costDisplay` / `ExchangeRate`). Both now compile and render end to end.

summary: The preview re-implements the three island-size formulas that are already available as `NotchIslandState.islandSize` inside the very fixture it compiles.
evidence: Tools/render-island-preview.py:290-303 hand-copies the formulas (`notch.width + 2 * IslandStyle.topFlare + 2 * IslandStyle.wingWidth`, `max(IslandStyle.minAlertWidth, ... + 200)`, `max(IslandStyle.minExpandedWidth, ... + 320)`) while the same file slices `final class NotchIslandState` from NotchIslandController.swift (line 106) — and that class already computes exactly these (`NotchIslandController.swift:31-58`: collapsedSize / alertSize / expandedSize / islandSize).
failure: Change `IslandStyle.minAlertWidth` or any padding constant and the probe keeps cropping to the old rectangle: the PNG is silently cut on the right edge (or padded) while `--check` still passes, because it asserts declarations exist, not values. The tool's stated purpose is to prevent exactly this kind of stale copy.
fix: Build the state first and use `state.islandSize` for `target` (the fixture constructs `NotchIslandState` at line 331 anyway), deleting `islandTargetSize` and its three copies of the geometry.
verdict_note: Fixed 2026-10-07: the probe's crop is `state.islandSize` — the same formula the panel uses — and `islandTargetSize` plus its three restated branches are deleted. `Tests/render-preview-regressions.py` pins that no `IslandStyle` size constant is re-stated in the tool.
